1
月五星犯列舍經星變附見
Transits of the moon and five planets against lunar lodges and principal fixed stars, with appended anomaly records.
2
魏文帝黃初四年三月癸卯，月犯心大星。 占曰：「心為天王位，王者惡之。 」六月甲申，太白晝見。 案劉向《五紀論》曰：「太白少陰，弱，不得專行，故以己未為界，不得經天而行。 經天則晝見，其占為兵喪，為不臣，為更王； 強國弱，小國強。 」是時孫權受魏爵號，而稱兵距守。 其十二月丙子，月犯心大星。 占同上。 五年十月乙卯，太白晝見。 占同上。 又歲星入太微逆行，積百四十九日乃出。 占曰：「五星入太微，從右入三十日以上，人主有大憂。 」一曰：「有赦至。 」七年五月，帝崩，明帝即位，大赦天下。 六年五月壬戌，熒惑入太微，至壬申，興歲星相及，俱犯右執法，至癸酉乃出。 占曰：「從右入三十日以上，人主有大憂。 」又曰：「月、五星犯左右執法，大臣有憂。 」一曰：「執法者誅，金、火尤甚。 」十一月，皇子東武陽王鑒薨。 七年正月，驃騎將軍曹洪免為庶人。 四月，征南大將軍夏侯尚薨。 五月，帝崩。 《蜀記》稱明帝問黃權曰：「天下鼎立，何地為正？ 」對曰：「當驗天文。 往者熒惑守心而文帝崩，吳、蜀無事，此其徵也。 」案三國史並無熒惑守心之文，疑是入太微。 八月，吳遂圍江夏，寇襄陽，大將軍宣帝救襄陽，斬吳將張霸等，兵喪更王之應也。
In the fourth year of Huangchu under Wei Emperor Wen, on the guimao day of the third lunar month, the moon transgressed the principal star of the Heart mansion. The divination reads, "Heart marks the ruler’s celestial throne; the sovereign dreads such an omen. In the sixth month, on jiashen, Venus appeared in daylight. Note Liu Xiang’s "Treatise on the Five Eras": Venus is minor yin and too faint to move independently, so within certain bounds it must not cross the meridian and traverse the full sky. When it crosses the zenith it becomes a daytime apparition, portending warfare and mourning, rebellious subjects, and dynastic turnover; Great powers decline while lesser polities rise. At the same time Sun Quan accepted Wei ennoblement while still mobilizing troops in defiance. In the twelfth month, on bingzi, the moon again transgressed the principal star of Heart. The same divination gloss applies as before. In the fifth year, tenth month, on yimao, Venus appeared in daylight. The same divination gloss applies as before. Moreover, Jupiter entered the Supreme Palace enclosure in retrograde motion and remained there one hundred forty-nine days before leaving. The text states, "If the five planets enter the Supreme Palace enclosure from the right and remain thirty days or more, the ruler faces grave peril. Another reading adds, "A general amnesty is impending. In the seventh year’s fifth month the emperor died; Emperor Ming succeeded and proclaimed a universal amnesty. In the fifth month of the sixth year, on renxu, Mars entered the Supreme Palace enclosure; by renshen it closed on Jupiter; both transgressed the Right Law Enforcer star; they cleared the region by guiyou. The gloss reads, "A right-hand ingress lasting thirty days or more foretells grave danger for the ruler. It adds, "Lunar or planetary transits across the Left or Right Law Enforcer augur anxiety for senior ministers. Another line warns, "Officials charged with justice face execution; Venus and Mars make the omen harshest. In the eleventh month Prince Jian of Dongwuyang, an imperial son, died. In the first month of the seventh year General of Agile Cavalry Cao Hong was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status. In the fourth month Grand General Who Conquers the South Xiahou Shang died. In the fifth month the emperor died. The Shu Record reports Emperor Ming asking Huang Quan which of the three rival states possessed the legitimate cosmic alignment. Huang Quan replied that the answer lay in inspecting the heavens. He cited Mars stationing at Heart when Emperor Wen died while Wu and Shu remained unscathed as the relevant precedent. Scrutiny shows no record of Mars actually stationing at Heart; the event was likely Mars entering the Supreme Palace enclosure. In the eighth month Wu besieged Jiangxia and struck Xiangyang; the Lord of Xuan led relief, slew Wu commanders such as Zhang Ba—fulfilling the omen of war, mourning, and shifting supremacy.
3
明帝太和五年五月，熒惑犯房。 占曰：「房四星，股肱臣將相位也，月、五星犯守之，將相有憂。 」其七月，車騎將軍張郃追諸葛亮，為亮所害。 十二月，太尉華歆薨。 其十一月乙酉，月犯軒轅大星。 占曰：「女主憂。 」六年三月乙亥，月又犯軒轅大星。 十一月寅，太白晝見南斗，遂歷八十餘日，恆見。 占曰：「吳有兵。 」明年，孫權遣張彌等將兵萬人，錫授公孫文懿為燕王，文懿斬彌等，虜其眾。 青龍三年正月，太后郭氏崩。
In the fifth month of the fifth Taihe year of Emperor Ming, Mars transgressed the Chamber mansion. The gloss identifies Chamber’s four stars with the sovereign’s chief ministers; lunar or planetary transits there threaten those officers. In the seventh month General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhang He died pursuing Zhuge Liang. In the twelfth month Grand Commandant Hua Xin died. In the same eleventh month, on yiyou, the moon transgressed the principal star of Xuanyuan (Regulus). The text foretells trouble for the empress or chief consort. In the third month of the sixth year, on yihai, the moon again transgressed Regulus. On the yin day of the eleventh month Venus stood in daylight within the Southern Dipper and remained visible more than eighty consecutive days. The gloss predicts military action involving Wu. The following year Sun Quan dispatched Zhang Mi with ten thousand men to enfeoff Gongsun Yuan as King of Yan; Yuan executed the envoys and captured the army. In the first month of the third Blue Dragon year Empress Dowager Guo died.
4
青龍三年三月辛卯，月犯輿鬼。 輿鬼主斬殺。 占曰：「人多病，國有憂。 」又曰：「大臣憂。 」是年夏及冬，大疫。 四年五月，司徒董昭薨。 其五月丁亥，太白晝見，積三十餘日。 以晷度推之，非秦魏，則楚也。 是時，諸葛亮據渭南，宣帝與相持； 孫權寇合肥，又遣陛議、孫韶等人淮沔，天子親東征。 蜀本秦地，則為秦魏及楚兵悉起矣。 其七月己巳，月犯楗閉。 占曰：「有火災。 」三年七月，崇華殿災。 三年六月丁未，填星犯井鉞。 戊戌，太白又犯之。 占曰：「凡月、五星犯井鉞，悉為兵災。 」一曰：「斧鉞用，大臣誅。 」七月己丑，填星犯東井距星。 占曰：「填星入井，大人憂。 」行近距，為行陰。 其占曰：「大水，五穀不成。 」景初元年夏，大水，傷五穀。 其年十月壬申，太白晝見，在尾，歷二百餘日，恆晝見。 占曰：「尾為燕，有兵。 」十二月戊辰，月犯鉤鈐。 占曰：「王者憂。 」四年閏正月己巳，填星犯井鉞。 三月癸卯，填星犯東井。 己巳，太白與月加景晝見。 五月壬寅，太白犯畢左股第一星。 占曰：「畢為邊兵，又主刑罰。 」九月，涼州塞外胡阿畢師使侵犯諸國，西域校尉張就討之，斬首捕虜萬計。 其年七月甲寅，太白犯軒轅大星。 占曰：「女主憂。 」景初元年，皇后毛氏崩。
In the third month of the third Blue Dragon year, on xinmao, the moon transgressed the Ghost asterism. The Ghost asterism presides over executions and slaughter. It warns of widespread sickness and national anxiety. A second reading adds peril for high ministers. That summer and winter a severe epidemic raged. In the fifth month of the fourth year Minister over the Masses Dong Zhao died. In the same fifth month, on dinghai, Venus shone in daylight for over thirty days. Shadow-rod reckoning assigned the omen to the Chu sector rather than Qin or Wei heartlands. Zhuge Liang was entrenched south of the Wei while the Lord of Xuan contained him; Sun Quan struck at Hefei and sent Lu Yi, Sun Shao, and others into the Huai-Han basin, prompting an eastern expedition by the emperor. Because Shu occupied the old Qin domain, the omen materialized as simultaneous warfare across the Qin, Wei, and Chu astrological divisions. In the seventh month, on jisi, the moon transgressed the Key-and-Bar stars. The gloss portends conflagration. In the seventh month of the third year the Chonghua Palace caught fire. In the sixth month of the third year, on dingwei, Saturn transgressed the axe star of Eastern Well. On wuxu Venus likewise transgressed that star. The text states that lunar or planetary hits on the Well axe-star always presage military calamity. Another line warns of capital punishment falling on senior officials. On jichou of the seventh month Saturn transgressed the separation star of Eastern Well. Saturn entering the Well mansion augurs anxiety for high lords. Passing close to the separation star is interpreted as motion along the yin side of the lodge. The associated reading predicts catastrophic flooding and crop failure. In the first Jingchu summer floods ruined the harvest. In the tenth month of that year, on renshen, Venus appeared in daylight in the Tail mansion and remained a daytime object for over two hundred days. Tail corresponds to the Yan region and foretells war. In the twelfth month, on wuchen, the moon transgressed the Hook-and-Lock stars. The king himself is said to face peril. In the intercalary first month of the fourth year, on jisi, Saturn again transgressed the Well axe-star. In the third month, on guimao, Saturn transgressed Eastern Well. On jisi Venus and the Moon were visible in daylight, their brilliance heightened against the sunlit sky. In the fifth month, on renyin, Venus transgressed the first star along the left thigh of the Net mansion. Net presides over frontier warfare and judicial punishments. In the ninth month Liangzhou frontier Hu led by Abi Shi’s envoys attacked neighboring states; Colonel of the Western Regions Zhang Jiu crushed them, taking tens of thousands of heads and captives. In the seventh month of that year, on jiayin, Venus transgressed Regulus. The omen again targets the chief consort. In the first Jingchu year Empress Mao died.
5
景初元年二月乙酉，月犯房第二星。 占曰：「將軍有憂。 」其七月，司徒陳矯薨。 二年四月，司徒韓暨薨。 其七月辛卯，太白晝見，積二百八十餘日。 時公孫文懿自立為燕王，署置百官，發兵距守，宣帝討滅之。 二年二月己丑，月犯心距星，又犯中央大星。 五月乙亥，月又犯心距星及中央大星。 案占曰：「王者惡之。 犯前星，太子有憂。 」三年正月，帝崩。 太子立，卒見廢。 其年十月甲午，月犯箕。 占曰：「將軍死。 」正始元年四月，車騎將軍黃權薨。 其閏十一月癸丑，月犯心中央大星。
In the first Jingchu year, second month, on yiyou, the moon transgressed the second star of Chamber. The gloss warns of danger to generals. In the seventh month Minister over the Masses Chen Jiao died. In the fourth month of the second year Minister over the Masses Han Ji died. In the seventh month, on xinmao, Venus remained a daytime object for over two hundred eighty days. Gongsun Yuan had styled himself King of Yan, set up a full bureaucracy, and resisted; the Lord of Xuan extirpated the regime. In the second month of the second year, on jichou, the moon transgressed Heart’s separation star and the central principal star. In the fifth month, on yihai, the moon repeated those transits across Heart. The compiled gloss states that the sovereign should dread such alignments. Striking the anterior star augurs trouble for the heir apparent. In the first month of the third year the emperor died. The new heir ascended yet was ultimately cast down. In the tenth month of that year, on jiawu, the moon transgressed Winnowing-Basket. The reading predicts a general’s death. In the fourth month of the first Zhengshi year General of Chariots and Cavalry Huang Quan died. In the intercalary eleventh month, on guichou, the moon transgressed the central great star of Heart.
6
少帝正始元年四月戊午，月犯昴東頭第一星。 十月庚寅，月又犯昴北斗四星。 占曰：「月犯昴，胡不安。 」二年六月，鮮卑阿妙兒等寇西方，敦煌太守王延破之，斬二萬餘級。 三年，又斬鮮卑大師及千餘級。 二年九月癸酉，月犯輿鬼西北星。 三年二月丁未，又犯西南星。 占曰：「有錢令。 」一曰：「大臣憂。 」三年三月，太尉滿寵薨。 四年正月，帝加元服，賜群臣錢各有差。 四年十月、十一月，月再犯井鉞。 是月，宣帝討諸葛恪，恪棄城走。 五年二月，曹爽征蜀。 五年十一月癸巳，填星犯亢距星。 占曰：「諸侯有失國者。 」七年七月丁丑，月犯左角。 占曰：「天下有兵，左將軍死。 」七月乙亥，熒惑犯畢距星。 占曰； 「有邊兵。 」一曰：「刑罰用。 」九年正月辛亥，月犯亢南星。 占曰：「兵起。 」一曰：「將軍死。 」七月癸丑，填星犯楗閉。 占曰：「王者不宜出宮下殿。 」嘉平元年，天子謁陵，宣帝奏誅曹爽等。 天子野宿，於是失勢。
In the first Zhengshi year of the young emperor, fourth month, wuwu, the moon transgressed the leading eastern star of the Hairy Head cluster. In the tenth month, on gengyin, the moon again transgressed the Pleiades region and the fourth star of the Northern Dipper. A lunar hit on Hairy Head unsettles the northern frontier peoples. In the sixth month of the second year Xianbei bands led by Amiao’er struck westward; Prefect of Dunhuang Wang Yan routed them, taking over twenty thousand heads. In the third year another campaign slew the Xianbei grand shaman and over a thousand others. In the ninth month of the second year, on guiyou, the moon transgressed the northwest star of Ghost. In the third year’s second month, on dingwei, it again transgressed the southwest star of Ghost. One reading speaks of a monetary ordinance or cash distribution. Another gloss still warns of anxiety for senior ministers. In the third month of the third year Grand Commandant Man Chong died. In the first month of the fourth year the emperor came of age ceremonially and granted sums of money to officials in graded gifts. In the tenth and eleventh months of the fourth year the moon twice transgressed the Well axe-star. That same month the Lord of Xuan attacked Zhuge Ke, who fled abandoning his city. In the second month of the fifth year Cao Shuang invaded Shu. In the eleventh month of the fifth year, on guisi, Saturn transgressed the separation star of the Neck mansion. The gloss foretells feudal lords stripped of their domains. In the seventh month of the seventh year, on dingchou, the moon transgressed the left Horn star. It predicts war across the realm and death for a general of the left. In the seventh month, on yihai, Mars transgressed the separation star of Net. The prognostication text continues: "Border warfare will erupt. A variant reading adds widespread use of criminal justice. In the first month of the ninth year, on xinhai, the moon transgressed the southern star of Neck. The omen signals the outbreak of arms. Another line again predicts a commander’s death. In the seventh month, on guichou, Saturn transgressed Key-and-Bar. The king is warned not to leave the palace or descend the main hall. In the first Jiaping year the emperor performed tomb rites while the Lord of Xuan secured an order to execute Cao Shuang’s faction. The emperor was forced to encamp abroad and thereafter forfeited real authority.
7
嘉平元年六月壬戌，太白犯東井距星。 占曰：「國失政，大臣為亂。 」四月辛巳，太白犯輿鬼。 占曰：「大臣誅。 」一曰：「兵起。 」二年三月己未，太白又犯井距星。 三年七月，王淩與楚王彪有謀，皆伏誅，人主遂卑。
In the sixth month of the first Jiaping year, on renxu, Venus transgressed the separation star of Eastern Well. The text foretells misrule at court and ministerial revolt. In the fourth month, on xinsi, Venus transgressed the Ghost asterism. Senior ministers face execution. An alternate reading again predicts war. In the third month of the second year, on jiwei, Venus again transgressed the Well separation star. In the seventh month of the third year Wang Ling and Cao Biao, Prince of Chu, were exposed and executed, greatly diminishing the throne’s stature.
8
吳孫權赤烏十三年夏五月，日北至，熒惑逆行，入南斗。 秋七月，犯魁第三星而東。 《漢晉春秋》云「逆行」。 案占：「熒惑入南斗，三月吳王死。 」一曰：「熒惑逆行，其地有死君。 」太元二年，權薨，是其應也，故《國志》書于吳。 是時，王淩謀立楚王彪，謂「斗中有星，當有暴貴者」，以問知星人浩詳。 詳疑有故，欲悅其意，不言吳有死喪，而言「淮南楚分，吳楚同占，當有王者興」，故淩計遂定。
In Wu, the thirteenth Red Crow year, the summer fifth month at the summer solstice, Mars turned retrograde and entered the Southern Dipper. By autumn’s seventh month it transgressed the third star of the dipper’s bowl and proceeded eastward. Han-Jin Spring and Autumn explicitly labels the motion as retrograde. Compiled lore states that Mars in the Southern Dipper foretells the Wu ruler’s death within three months. Retrograde Mars over a territory likewise augurs a ruler’s death. Sun Quan died in the second Taikang year, matching the omen, so the National Records assign the observation to Wu. Wang Ling, scheming to elevate Prince Biao, cited an unusual star in the Dipper as a sign of sudden greatness and consulted Hao Xiang. Hao Xiang, doubting Wang Ling’s purpose, avoided predicting Wu’s bereavement and instead claimed Huainan’s Chu sector meant a new king would arise, which hardened Ling’s resolve.
9
嘉平二年十二月丙申，月犯輿鬼。 三年四月戊寅，月犯東井。 五月甲寅，月犯亢距星。 占曰：「將軍死。 」一曰：「為兵。 」是月，王淩、楚王彪等誅。 七月，皇后甄氏崩。 四年三月，吳將為寇，鎮東將軍諸葛誕破走之。 其年七月己巳，月犯輿鬼。 九月乙巳，又犯之。 十月癸未，熒惑犯亢南星。 占曰：「臣有亂。 」四年十一月丁未，月又犯鬼積尸。 五年六月戊午，太白犯角。 占曰：「群臣有謀，不成。 」庚辰，月犯箕星。 占曰：「將軍死。 」七月，月犯井鉞。 丙午，月又犯鬼西北星。 占曰：「國有憂。 」十一月癸酉，月犯東井距星。 占曰：「將軍死。 」正元元年正月，鎮東將軍毋丘儉、揚州刺史文欽反，兵俱敗，誅死。 二月，李豐及弟翼、後父張緝等謀亂，事泄，悉誅，皇后張氏廢。 九月，帝廢為齊王。 蜀將姜維攻隴西，車騎將軍郭淮討破之。
In the twelfth month of the second Jiaping year, on bingshen, the moon transgressed Ghost. In the fourth month of the third year, on wuyin, the moon transgressed Eastern Well. In the fifth month, on jiayin, the moon transgressed Neck’s separation star. The gloss again predicts a commander’s death. Another reading simply foretells warfare. That month Wang Ling, Prince Biao, and their confederates were put to death. In the seventh month Empress Zhen died. In the third month of the fourth year Wu commanders invaded; General Who Guards the East Zhuge Dan drove them off. In the seventh month of that year, on jisi, the moon transgressed Ghost. In the ninth month, on yisi, it transgressed Ghost again. In the tenth month, on guiwei, Mars transgressed Neck’s southern star. The text warns of mutiny among ministers. In the eleventh month of the fourth year, on dingwei, the moon again transgressed the heaped-corpse cluster in Ghost. In the sixth month of the fifth year, on wuwu, Venus transgressed the Horn mansion. Courtiers intrigue yet fail to carry a coup through. On gengchen the moon transgressed a star in Winnowing-Basket. Another death omen for generals follows. In the seventh month the moon transgressed the Well axe-star. On bingwu the moon again transgressed Ghost’s northwest star. The state faces grave concern. In the eleventh month, on guiyou, the moon transgressed Eastern Well’s separation star. The gloss again predicts a general’s death. In the first month of the first Zhengyuan year General Who Guards the East Guanqiu Jian and Inspector of Yang Province Wen Qin rose in revolt, lost their armies, and were executed. In the second month Li Feng, Li Yi, Empress Zhang’s father Zhang Ji, and others conspired; exposed, they were slain and Empress Zhang was cast aside. In the ninth month the emperor was demoted to Prince of Qi. Shu’s Jiang Wei struck Longxi; General of Chariots and Cavalry Guo Huai repulsed him.
10
高貴鄉公正元二年二月戊午，熒惑犯東井北轅西頭第一星。 甘露元年七月乙卯，熒惑犯東井鉞星。 壬戌，月又犯鉞星。 八月辛亥，月犯箕。
In the second Zhengyuan year of the Duke of Gaoxiang, second month, wuwu, Mars transgressed the leading western star on the northern yoke of Eastern Well. In the first Ganlu year, seventh month, on yimao, Mars transgressed the Well axe-star. On renxu the moon again transgressed the axe-star. In the eighth month, on xinhai, the moon transgressed Winnowing-Basket.
11
吳廢孫亮太平元年九月壬辰，太白犯南斗，《吳志》所書也。 占曰：「太白犯斗，國有兵，大臣有反者。 」其明年，諸葛誕反。 又明年，孫綝廢亮。 吳魏並有兵事也。
When Wu deposed Sun Liang, in the first Taiping year’s ninth month, on renchen, Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper—the entry appears in the Wu Annals. Venus striking the Dipper presages war and treason among great ministers. The following year Zhuge Dan rose in rebellion. The year after that Sun Chen removed Sun Liang. Both Wu and Wei saw major campaigning.
12
甘露元年九月丁巳，月犯東井。 二年六月己酉，月犯心中央大星。 八月壬子，歲星犯井鉞。 九月庚寅，歲星逆行，乘井鉞。 十月丙寅，太白犯亢距星。 占曰：「逆臣為亂，人君憂。 」景元元年五月，有成濟之變及諸葛誕誅，皆其應也。 二年三月庚子，太白犯東井。 占曰：「國失政，大臣為亂。 」是夜，歲星又犯東井。 占曰：「兵起。 」至景元元年，高貴鄉公敗。 三年八月壬辰，歲星犯輿鬼鑕星。 占曰：「斧鑕用，大臣誅。 」四年四月甲申，歲星又犯輿鬼東南星。 占曰：「鬼東南星主兵，木入鬼，大臣誅。 」景元元年，殺尚書王經。
In the first Ganlu year’s ninth month, on dingsi, the moon transgressed Eastern Well. In the sixth month of the second year, on jiyou, the moon transgressed Heart’s central great star. In the eighth month, on renzi, Jupiter transgressed the Well axe-star. In the ninth month, on gengyin, Jupiter moved retrograde across the Well axe-star. In the tenth month, on bingyin, Venus transgressed Neck’s separation star. Rebellious subjects stir turmoil and the ruler faces anxiety. In the fifth month of the first Jingyuan year the Cheng Ji coup and Zhuge Dan’s liquidation fulfilled these omens. In the third month of the second year, on gengzi, Venus transgressed Eastern Well. The same gloss of misrule and ministerial revolt applies. That same night Jupiter again transgressed Eastern Well. The reading again signals war. By the first Jingyuan year the Duke of Gaoxiang had been overthrown. In the eighth month of the third year, on renchen, Jupiter transgressed the execution-blade star in Ghost. Capital punishment falls on high officials when this star is struck. In the fourth month of the fourth year, on jiashen, Jupiter again transgressed Ghost’s southeast star. The southeast star of Ghost rules military affairs; Jupiter entering Ghost beheads ministers. In the first Jingyuan year Minister Wang Jing was executed.
13
元帝景元元年二月，月犯建星。 案占：「月五星犯建星，大臣相譖。 」是後鍾會、鄧艾破蜀，會譖艾。 二年四月，熒惑入太微，犯右執法。 占曰：「人主有大憂。 」一云：「大臣憂。 」四年十月，歲星守房。 占曰：「將相憂。 」一云：「有大赦。 」明年，鄧艾、鍾會皆夷滅，赦蜀土。 五年，帝遜位。
In the second month of the first Jingyuan year of the Wei prince, the moon transgressed the Establishment asterism. Compiled lore states that lunar or planetary hits on the Establishment stars pit chief ministers against each other through slander. Later Zhong Hui and Deng Ai conquered Shu, whereupon Hui denounced Ai. In the fourth month of the second year Mars entered the Supreme Palace enclosure and transgressed the Right Law Enforcer. The ruler faces supreme peril. Another manuscript reads anxiety for great ministers instead. In the tenth month of the fourth year Jupiter stationed at Chamber. Generals and chancellors face danger. An alternate gloss promises a sweeping pardon. The next year Deng Ai and Zhong Hui were annihilated and the Shu lands received clemency. In the fifth year the emperor abdicated.
14
武帝咸寧四年九月，太白當見不見。 占曰：「是謂失舍，不有破軍，必有亡國。 」是時羊祜表求伐吳，上許之。 五年十一月，兵出，太白始夕見西方。 太康元年三月，大破吳軍，孫皓面縛請罪，吳國遂亡。
In the ninth month of the fourth Xianning year of Emperor Wu, Venus should have been visible but failed to appear. The gloss calls it a "lost station" omen: expect either annihilation in the field or outright dynastic collapse. Yang Hu then petitioned for the conquest of Wu, and the throne gave its assent. That November the host marched; Venus made its first evening appearance in the western sky. In Taikang 1 (280), third month, Wu’s armies were shattered, Sun Hao surrendered in bonds, and the Wu kingdom ceased to exist.
15
太康八年三月，熒惑守心。 占曰：「王者惡之。 」太熙元年四月乙酉，帝崩。
In Taikang 8 (287), third month, Mars stationed in the Heart constellation. The canon again warned the sovereign of mortal ill. On yiyou in the fourth month of Taixi 1 (290) the emperor died.
16
惠帝元康三年四月，熒惑守太微六十日。 占曰：「諸侯三公謀其上，必有斬臣。 」一曰：「天子亡國。 」是春太白守畢，至是百餘日。 占曰：「有急令之憂。 」一曰：「相死。 」又為邊境不安。 後賈后陷殺太子。 六年十月乙未，太白晝見。 九年六月，熒惑守心。 占曰：「王者惡之。 」八月，熒惑入羽林。 占曰：「禁兵大起。 」其後，帝見廢為太上皇，俄而三王起兵討趙王倫，倫悉遣中軍兵相距累月。
In Emperor Hui’s Yuankang 3 (293), fourth month, Mars lingered inside the Supreme Palace Enclosure for sixty days. It foretold high nobles scheming against the throne and a minister dying by the axe. Another gloss warned of outright loss of the realm. All spring Venus had stationed in the Net asterism—well over a hundred days by then. It portended frantic emergency decrees from the palace. A variant reading singled out the chief minister’s death. The same configuration augured trouble along the frontiers. Soon Empress Jia engineered the crown prince’s murder. On yiwei in the tenth month of Yuankang 6 Venus appeared in broad daylight. In the ninth year’s sixth month Mars again stationed in the Heart. The sovereign was again marked for calamity. In the eighth month Mars moved into the Feathered Forest guard asterism. It foretold palace armies mobilizing en masse. The emperor was soon demoted to retired emperor; then the three princes rose against Prince Sima Lun of Zhao, who threw every central-garrison regiment into months of stalemate.
17
永康元年三月，中台星坼，太白晝見。 占曰：「台星失常，三公憂。 太白晝見，為不臣。 」是月，賈后殺太子，趙王倫尋廢殺後，斬司空張華。 其五月，熒惑入南斗。 占曰：「宰相死，兵大起。 斗，又吳分野。 」是時，趙王倫為相，明年，篡位，三王興師誅之。 太安二年，石冰破揚州。 其八月，熒惑入箕。 占曰：「人主失位，兵起。 」明年趙王倫篡位，改元。 二年二月，太白出西方，逆行入東井。 占曰：「國失政，大臣為亂。 」是時，齊王冏起兵討趙王倫，倫滅，冏擁兵不朝，專權淫奢，明年，誅死。
In Yongkang 1’s third month a Central Court star fractured while Venus shone by day. A fractured terrace star boded ill for the three excellencies. Daylight Venus signals treasonous subjects. That same month Empress Jia murdered the crown prince; Sima Lun then toppled and slew the empress and executed Zhang Hua, Minister of Works. That May Mars entered the Southern Dipper. The omen promised a chief minister’s death and major war. The Dipper also marks Wu’s celestial territory. Sima Lun was then chief minister; the following year he seized the throne, only for the three princes’ coalition to crush him. In Taian 2 (303) Shi Bing overran Yangzhou. That August Mars crossed the Winnowing Basket. It foretold dethronement and rebellion. The next year Sima Lun usurped the throne and proclaimed a new era. In the second month of Yongning 2 Venus rose in the west and backed into the Eastern Well. Misrule and ministerial revolt were again portended. Prince Sima Jiong of Qi marched against Sima Lun, destroyed him, then quartered his army in the capital, grew insolent and overbearing, and was executed the following year.
18
永甯元年，自正月至於閏月，五星互經天，縱橫無常。 《星傳》曰：「日陽，君道也； 星陰，臣道也。 日出則星亡，臣不得專也。 晝而星見午上者為經天，其占為不臣，為更王。 」今五星悉經天，天變所未有也。 石氏說曰：「辰星晝見，其國不亡則大亂。 」是後，台鼎方伯，互執大權，二帝流亡，遂至六夷更王，迭據華夏，亦載籍所未有也。 其四月，歲星晝見。 五月，太白晝見。 占同前。 七月，歲星守虛危。 占曰：「木守虛危，有兵憂。 虛危，齊分。 」一曰：「守虛，饑； 守危，徭役煩多，下屈竭。 」辰星入太微，占曰「為內亂」，一曰「群臣相殺」。 太白守右掖門，占曰：「為兵，為亂，為賊。 」八月戊午，填星犯左執法，又犯上相，占曰「上相憂」。 熒惑守昴，占曰「趙魏有災」。 辰星守輿鬼，占曰「秦有災」。 九月丁未，月犯左角。 占曰：「人主憂。 」一曰：「左衛將軍死，天下有兵。 」二年四月癸酉，歲星晝見。 占曰：「為臣強。 」初，齊王冏定京都，因留輔政，遂專慠無君。 是月，成都、河間檄長沙王乂討之，冏乂交戰，攻焚宮闕，冏兵敗，夷滅。 又殺其兄上軍將軍寔以下二十餘人。 太安二年，成都攻長沙，於是公私饑困，百姓力屈。
From New Year through the leap month of Yongning 1 (301) all five planets in turn transited in broad daylight, weaving unpredictably across the zenith. The *Star Canon* explains: the sun embodies yang—the ruler’s path; stars embody yin—the ministers’ path." When the sun rises the stars vanish, for subjects must not eclipse their sovereign. Stars visible at noon count as "crossing the sky," portending treason and dynastic turnover." Never had all five planets crossed the meridian by day—an omen without precedent in the annals." Shi Shen’s school warns that Mercury by day means either ruin or utter turmoil. Terrace secretaries and provincial governors then wrested real authority; two emperors fled the capital; steppe peoples took turns enthroning themselves across the North—another novelty unlisted in older star lore." That April Jupiter shone in daylight. In May Venus appeared by day. The same omen readings applied as earlier. In July Jupiter stationed between Emptiness and Rooftop. Jupiter lingering there augurs war and worry. That sector maps onto the old Qi heartland. One gloss adds: a long stay over Emptiness promises famine; over Rooftop it means crushing levies and a drained populace." Mercury in the Supreme Palace Enclosure reads as palace turmoil—or ministers turning blades on one another." Venus guarding the right palace gate foretells arms, riot, and brigandage." On wuwu in August Saturn struck the Left Enforcer and the Upper Minister stars—ill omens for the senior minister." Mars stationed in the Net sector boded disaster for Zhao and Wei. Mercury lingering on the Ghosts predicted calamity in the old Qin region. On dingwei in the ninth month the Moon crossed the eastern Horn star. The sovereign was warned of personal peril. Another gloss added the death of the Left Guard general and nationwide war. On guiyou in the fourth month of Yongning 2 Jupiter appeared in daylight. It warned that subjects would overpower their ruler. Earlier Sima Jiong had rescued Luoyang and stayed on as regent, growing insolent and treating the emperor as a cipher. That month the princes of Chengdu and Hejian called on Sima Yi of Changsha to attack Jiong; their armies clashed, torched the palaces, and annihilated Jiong’s host. They slew his elder brother Sima Shi, Upper Army general, and over twenty of his kin and lieutenants. In Taian 2 the Prince of Chengdu besieged the Prince of Changsha, plunging court and countryside into famine and utter exhaustion.
19
太安二年二月，太白入昴。 占曰：「天下擾，兵大起。 」七月，熒惑入東井。 占曰：「兵起，國亂。 」是秋，太白守太微上將。 占曰：「上將以兵亡。 」是年冬，成都、河間攻洛陽。 八月，長沙王奉帝出距二王。 三年正月，東海王越執長沙王乂，張方又殺之。 三年正月，熒惑入南斗，占同永康。 七月，左衛將軍陳眕率眾奉帝伐成都，六軍敗績，兵逼乘輿。 是時，天下盜賊群起，張昌尤盛。
In Taian 2’s second month Venus entered the Net asterism. The realm would convulse in great war. In July Mars entered the Eastern Well. Arms and civil disorder were portended. That autumn Venus stationed on the Supreme Palace’s Supreme Minister star. It foretold the chief minister’s death in fighting. That winter the armies of Chengdu and Hejian struck toward Luoyang. In August Sima Yi of Changsha marched the sovereign out to face the allied princes. In the third year’s first month Sima Yue of the East Sea captured Sima Yi of Changsha, whereupon Zhang Fang put him to death. That same January Mars re-entered the Southern Dipper—the Yongkang omen applied again. In July Left Guard commander Chen Zhen escorted the emperor against the Prince of Chengdu; the six hosts were routed and rebels closed on the imperial train. Rebels sprang up everywhere, Zhang Chang’s horde foremost among them.
20
永興元年七月庚申，太白犯角、亢，經房、心，歷尾、箕。 九月，入南斗。 占曰：「犯角，天下大戰； 犯亢，有大兵，人君憂； 入房心，為兵喪； 犯尾箕，女主憂。 」一曰：「天下大亂。 入南斗，有兵喪。 」一曰：「將軍為亂。 其所犯守，又兗、豫、幽、冀、揚州之分野。 」是年七月，有蕩陰之役。 九月，王浚殺幽州刺史和演，攻鄴，鄴潰，於是兗豫為天下兵衝。 陳敏又亂揚土。 劉元海、石勒、李雄等並起微賤，跨有州郡。 皇后羊氏數被幽廢。 皆其應也。 二年四月丙子，太白犯狼星。 占曰：「大兵起。 」九月，歲星守東井。 占曰：「有兵，井又秦分野。 」是年，苟晞破公師籓，張方破范陽王猇，關西諸將攻河間王顒，顒奔走，東海王迎殺之。
On gengshen in Yongxing 1’s seventh month Venus cut through Horn, Neck, Room, Heart, Tail, and the Winnowing Basket in succession. By September it had entered the Southern Dipper. The gloss reads: a Horn transit means empire-wide battle; a Neck hit signals massed armies and the ruler’s fear; Room and Heart entries mean war and imperial mourning; Tail and Winnowing Basket transits target the empress." Another line simply predicted universal turmoil. Entry into the Dipper again augured war and mourning." A further gloss warned of a mutinous commander. The stars it touched mapped onto Yan, Yu, You, Ji, and Yangzhou—exactly where armies now raged." That July saw the slaughter at Dangyin. In September Wang Jun murdered Youzhou Inspector He Yan, stormed Ye, and took the city, turning Yan and Yu into the war-torn heart of the empire. Chen Min then ravaged the lower Yangzi. Liu Yuan, Shi Le, Li Xiong, and other upstarts from the margins carved out provincial empires. Empress Yang suffered repeated deposition and house arrest. Each event matched the omens. On bingzi in the fourth month of Yongxing 2 Venus crossed the Wolf star. Major mobilization was foretold. In September Jupiter stationed in the Eastern Well. War was portended, and the Well sector still marks the old Qin lands." That year Gou Xi broke Gongshi Fan, Zhang Fang routed Sima Xiao of Fanyang, Guanxi generals drove Sima Yong of Hejian to flight, and Sima Yue of the East Sea intercepted and slew him.
21
光熙元年四月，太白失行，自翼入尾、箕。 占曰：「太白失行而北，是謂反生。 不有破軍，必有屠城。 」五月，汲桑攻鄴，魏郡太守馮嵩出戰，大敗，桑遂害東燕王騰，殺萬餘人，焚燒魏時宮室皆盡。 其九月丁未，熒惑守心。 占曰：「王者惡之。 」己亥，填星守房、心。 占曰：「填守房，多禍喪； 守心，國內亂，天下赦。 」是時，司馬越專權，終以無禮破滅，內亂之應也。 十一月，帝崩，懷帝即位，大赦天下。
In Guangxi 1’s fourth month Venus wandered off course, sliding from the Wings mansion through Tail into the Winnowing Basket. The omen reads: when Venus strays northward, it is termed a reversal of fortune—an ill omen of resurgent violence. Either a field army will be shattered or a city will be put to the sword. In the fifth month, Ji Sang struck Ye. Wei’s prefect Feng Song rode out to meet him and was routed. Ji Sang then killed Prince Teng of Eastern Yan, massacred over ten thousand people, and razed the old Wei palaces to ash. On the dingwei day of the ninth month that year, Mars stationed itself in the Heart. The omen warns that the sovereign should dread this sign. On jihai, Saturn stood fixed in Fang and the Heart. The text says Saturn lingering in Fang foretells repeated calamity and bereavement; when it halts in the Heart, civil strife follows and a general pardon sweeps the empire." Sima Yue had seized the government and, for his arrogance and breach of ritual, was eventually ruined—exactly the domestic turmoil the stars had portended. The emperor died that November; Huai succeeded and proclaimed a general amnesty.
22
懷帝永嘉元年十二月丁亥，星流震散。 按劉向說，天官列宿，在位之象； 其眾小星無名者，眾庶之類。 此百官眾庶將流散之象也。 是後天下大亂，百官萬姓，流移轉死矣。 二年正月庚午，太白伏不見，二月庚子，始晨見東方，是謂當見不見，占同上條。 其後破軍殺將，不可勝數，帝崩虜庭，中夏淪覆。 三年正月庚子，熒惑犯紫微。 占曰：「當有野死之王，又為火燒宮。 」是時太史令高堂沖奏，乘輿宜遷幸，不然必無洛陽。 五年六月，劉曜、王彌入京都，焚燒宮廊，執帝歸平陽。 三年，填星久守南斗。 占曰：「填星所居久者，其國有福。 」是時，安東將軍、琅邪王始有揚土。 其年十一月，地動，陳卓以為是地動應也。 五年十月，熒惑守心。 六年六月丁卯，太白犯太微。 占曰：「兵入天子庭，王者惡之。 」七月，帝崩於寇庭，天下行服大臨。
On dinghai in the twelfth month of Huai’s Yongjia 1, meteors streaked and burst in showers. Liu Xiang held that the major constellations mirror men in high position; the nameless lesser stars stand for the common people. Thus the sky foretold the dispersal of officials and populace alike. Soon the realm descended into chaos; countless officials and families were uprooted and perished on the road. In year two, Venus vanished on gengwu of the first month and only reappeared at dawn in the east on gengzi of the second—an ‘invisible when expected’ omen matching the earlier rule. There followed uncountable routs and slain commanders; the sovereign died a captive among the nomads, and the heartland fell. On gengzi of the first month of the third year, Mars trespassed into the Purple Palace. The omen speaks of a ruler dying away from his capital and of flames consuming the halls. Court astronomer Gao Tang Chong urged the throne to flee the capital or lose Luoyang entirely. In the sixth month of the fifth year Liu Yao and Wang Mi took the capital, set the palace corridors ablaze, seized the sovereign, and marched him back to Pingyang. Through the third year Saturn lingered in the Southern Dipper. The canon says prolonged Saturn residence brings fortune to the land beneath it. Meanwhile the Prince of Langye, General Who Pacifies the East, was first securing his hold on the Yangzhou region. Earth tremors struck that November; Chen Zhuo read them as the terrestrial echo of the omen. In the tenth month of the fifth year Mars again stationed itself in the Heart. On dingmao of the sixth month of the sixth year Venus crossed into the Supreme Palace Enclosure. The omen warns of troops in the imperial precincts—a thing every ruler fears. The following July the sovereign perished in captivity, and the realm went into deep mourning.
23
元帝太興元年七月，太白犯南斗。 占曰：「吳越有兵，大人憂。 」二年二月甲申，熒惑犯東井。 占曰：「兵起，貴臣相戮。 」八月己卯，太白犯軒轅大星。 占曰：「後宮憂。 」三年五月己戊子，太白入太微，又犯上將星。 占曰：「天子自將，上將誅。 」九月，太白犯南斗。 十月己亥，熒惑在東井，居五諸侯南，踟躕留積三十日。 占曰：「熒惑守井二十日以上，大人憂。 守五諸侯，諸侯有誅者。 」永昌元年三月，王敦率江荊之眾來攻京都，六軍距戰，敗績，人主謝過而已。 於是殺護軍將軍周顗、尚書令刁協、驃騎將軍戴若思。 又，鎮北將軍劉隗出奔。 四月，又殺湘州刺史譙王司馬承、鎮南將軍甘卓。 閏十二月，帝崩。
In Yuan’s Taixing 1, Venus trespassed the Southern Dipper in the seventh month. The text predicts war in the southeast and anxiety among the great. On jiashen of the second month of the second year Mars entered the Eastern Well. The omen foretells mobilization and mutual slaughter among the elite. On jimao of the eighth month Venus brushed the great Coach-and-Courts star. The wives’ quarters were warned of trouble ahead. In the fifth month of the third year, on the day read as wuzi in corrected almanacs, Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and again struck the supreme general star; the stem-branch in the received text is defective. The omen speaks of the emperor taking the field and a top commander paying with his life. That September Venus again crossed the Southern Dipper. From jihai in the tenth month Mars lingered in the Well south of the Five Feudal Lords, dawdling there a full month. The canon says Mars tarrying in the Well beyond twenty days alarms the mighty. If it halts on the Five Feudal Lords, one regional lord will be put to death. In Yongchang 1 Wang Dun marched the Jing–Jiang armies on the capital; the imperial host was beaten, and the emperor could only offer a humiliating apology. Zhou Yi, Diao Xie, and Dai Ruosi—champion general, chief minister, and swift cavalry commander—were then executed. Liu Wei, General Who Garrisons the North, also fled the court. The next month Prince Cheng of Qiao, Xiang’s governor, and southern garrison commander Gan Zhuo were slain as well. The emperor died in the leap twelfth month.
24
明帝太寧三年正月，熒惑逆行，入太微。 占曰：「為兵喪，王者惡之。 」閏八月，帝崩。 後二年，蘇峻反，攻焚宮室，太后以憂逼崩，天子幽劫于石頭城，遠近兵亂，至四年乃息。
Early in Ming’s Taining 3 Mars backed into the Supreme Palace Enclosure. The omen promises war, bereavement, and royal dread. He died in the leap eighth month. Two years later Su Jun rose, torched the palaces, and drove the empress dowager to her death; the young sovereign was held hostage at Stone City while fighting raged until it finally subsided in the fourth year.
25
成帝咸和六年正月丙辰，月入南斗。 占曰：「有兵。 」是月，石勒殺略婁、武進二縣人。 明年，石勒眾又抄略南沙、海虞。 其十一月，熒惑守胃昴。 占曰：趙魏有兵。 」八年七月，石勒死，石季龍自立。 是時，雖二石僭號，而其強弱常占於昴，不關太微、紫宮也。 八年三月己巳，月入南斗。 與六年占同。 其年七月，石勒死，彭彪以譙，石生以長安，郭權以秦州並歸順。 於是遣督護喬球率眾救彪，彪敗，球退。 又，石季龍、石斌攻滅生、權。 其七月，熒惑入昴。 占曰：「胡王死。 」一曰：「趙地有兵。 」是月，石勒死，石季龍多所攻沒。 八月，月又犯昴。 占曰：「胡不安。 」九年三月己亥，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。 占曰：「兵在西北，有沒軍死將。 」六月、八月，月又犯昴。 是時，石弘雖襲勒位，而石季龍擅威橫暴，十一月廢弘自立，遂幽殺之。
Under Emperor Cheng, in the sixth year of Xianhe, on bingchen in the first month, the moon passed into the Southern Dipper asterism. The omen text read: armed conflict would follow. That same month Shi Le massacred and looted the populations of Lou and Wujin counties. The year after, his army again swept through Nansha and Haiyu. That November Mars stationed between the Stomach and Hairy Head lunar lodges. The interpretation warned of war in the Zhao and Wei heartlands. In the seventh month of the eighth year Shi Le died and Shi Hu (Jilong) seized supreme authority. Even while both Shis bore illegitimate royal styles, their waxing and waning were read chiefly from Hairy Head, not from the sovereign asterisms Taiwei and Ziwei. In the third month of the eighth year, on jisi, the moon entered Southern Dipper. The reading matched the sixth-year omen for the same phenomenon. That July, upon Shi Le's death, Peng Biao at Qiao, Shi Sheng at Chang'an, and Guo Quan in Qinzhou all came over to Jin. Jin then sent Supervising Protector Qiu Qiu to relieve Peng Biao; Biao was routed and Qiu pulled back. Shi Hu and Shi Bin then campaigned against and destroyed Shi Sheng and Guo Quan. In that same seventh month Mars entered the Hairy Head lodge. The omen declared the death of a northern barbarian ruler. An alternate gloss predicted fighting in the Zhao territories. That month Shi Le died, and Shi Hu launched widespread offensives that overran numerous districts. In the eighth month the moon again occulted or brushed Hairy Head. The reading warned of unrest among the northern regimes. On jihai in the third month of the ninth year Mars entered Ghost and crossed the Heap of Corpses cluster. The gloss foretold northwestern campaigns with drowned hosts and fallen commanders. The moon repeated its encroachment on Hairy Head in the sixth and again in the eighth month. Shi Hong had succeeded Shi Le in name, but Shi Hu wielded real power with brutal force; in the eleventh month he deposed Hong, proclaimed himself ruler, then had him confined and murdered.
26
咸康元年二月己亥，太白犯昴。 占曰：「兵起，歲中旱。 」四月，石季龍略騎至歷陽，加司徒王道大司馬，治兵列戍衝要。 是時，石季龍又圍襄陽。 六月，旱。 其年三月丙戌，月入昴。 占曰：「胡王死。 」八月戊戌，熒惑入東井。 占曰：「無兵，兵起； 有兵，兵止。 」十一月，月犯昴。 二年正月辛亥，月犯房南第二星。 八月，月又犯昴。 九月庚寅，太白犯南斗，因晝見。 占曰：「斗為宰相，又揚州分，金犯之，死喪之象。 晝見，為不臣，又為兵喪。 」其後，石季龍僭稱天王，發眾七萬； 四年二月自隴西攻殺段遼於薊，又襲慕容皝於棘城，不克，皝擊破其將麻秋，並虜段遼殺之。 三年七月己酉，月犯房上星。 八月，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。 甲戌，月犯東井距星。 九月戊子，月犯建星。 四年四月己巳，太白晝見，在柳。 占曰：「為兵，為不臣。 」明年，石季龍大寇沔南，於是內外戒嚴。 其五月戊戌，熒惑犯右執法。 占曰：「大臣死，執政者憂。 」九月，太白又犯右執法。 案占：「五星災同，金火尤甚。 」十一月戊子，太白犯房上星。 占曰：「上相憂。 」五年四月乙未，月犯畢距星。 占曰：「兵起。 」七月己酉，月犯房上星。 占曰：「將相憂。 」是月庚申，丞相王導薨，庾冰代輔政。 八月，太尉郗鑒薨。 又有沔南邾城之敗，百姓流亡萬餘家。 六年正月，征西大將軍庾亮薨。 六年三月甲辰，熒惑犯太微外將星。 占曰：「上將憂。 」四月丁丑，熒惑犯右執法。 占曰：「執政者憂。 」六月乙亥，月犯牽牛中央星。 占曰：「大將憂。 」是時，尚書今何充為執法，有譴，欲避其咎，明年求為中書令。 其四月丙午，太白犯畢距星。 占曰：「兵革起。 」一曰：「女主憂。 」六月乙卯，太白犯軒轅大星。 占曰：「女主憂。 」七年三月，皇后杜氏崩。 七年三月壬午，月犯房。 四月己丑，太白入輿鬼。 五月，太白晝見。 八月辛丑，月犯輿鬼。 八年六月，熒惑犯房上第二星。 占曰：「次相憂。 」八月壬寅，月犯畢。 占曰：「下犯上，兵革起。 」十月，月又掩畢大星。 占同上。 其建元二年，車騎將軍庾冰薨。 庾翼大發兵，謀伐石季龍，專制上流，朝廷憚之。
In the first year of Xiankang, on jihai in the second month, Venus crossed Hairy Head. The omen paired war with a midsummer drought. In the fourth month Shi Hu's raiding horsemen pushed to Liyang; Wang Dao was promoted to grand marshal and troops were mobilized to hold the strategic defiles. About the same time Shi Hu renewed his siege of Xiangyang. A severe drought struck in the sixth month. On bingxu in the third month of that year the moon entered Hairy Head. The same death-of-barbarian-king gloss was recorded again. On wuxu in the eighth month Mars entered the Eastern Well asterism. One branch of the omen read: peace breeds mobilization; where armies are already in the field, they will instead stand down. In the eleventh month the moon again trespassed on Hairy Head. On xinhai in the first month of the second year the moon crossed the southern second star of the Room lodge. The eighth month saw another lunar approach to Hairy Head. On gengyin in the ninth month Venus crossed Southern Dipper and appeared in daylight. The gloss identified the Dipper with chief ministers and the Yangzhou celestial field; Venus intruding there betokened mortality and lamentation. Daytime visibility implied disloyal ministers and further augured war and bereavement. Thereafter Shi Hu arrogated the style Heavenly King and marched seventy thousand men. In the second month of the fourth year he struck from Longxi, slew Duan Liao at Ji, then struck Murong Huang at Jicheng but failed; Huang routed his general Ma Qiu, took Duan Liao captive, and executed him. On jiyou in the seventh month of the third year the moon crossed the upper star of Room. In the eighth month Mars entered Ghost and crossed the Heap of Corpses. On jiaxu the moon impinged on the separator star of Eastern Well. On wuzi in the ninth month the moon crossed the Establishment asterism. On jisi in the fourth month of the fourth year Venus shone in daylight within the Willow lodge. The reading cited war and treasonous ministers. The following year Shi Hu launched a major incursion south of the Han River, and the court declared full civil and military mobilization. On wuxu in that fifth month Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer star in Taiwei. The gloss foretold the death of senior ministers and anxiety for the men at the helm of government. That ninth month, Venus again transgressed the star Right Law Enforcement. The manuals state: "When multiple of the Five Planets portend disaster at once, Venus and Mars are the gravest." On the Wuzi day in the eleventh month, Venus trespassed the upper star of the Room asterism. The omen read: "The chief minister faces peril." In the fifth year, on Yiwei in the fourth month, the Moon occulted the Net's gap star. The omen read: "War will break out." On Jiyou in the seventh month, the Moon trespassed the upper star of the Room. The omen read: "Generals and ministers are imperiled." That same month, on Gengshen, Chancellor Wang Dao died, and Yu Bing took his place at the helm of government. In the eighth month Grand Commandant Xi Jian passed away. There was also the rout at Zhucheng south of the Han, sending over ten thousand households into flight. In the sixth year's first month the western commander-in-chief Yu Liang died. On Jiachen in the third month of the sixth year, Mars trespassed the outer general star of Supreme Subtlety. The omen read: "The senior field commander faces danger." On Dingchou in the fourth month, Mars transgressed Right Law Enforcement. The omen read: "The ruling ministers are at risk." On Yihai in the sixth month, the Moon trespassed the central star of the Ox. The omen read: "The commander-in-chief faces misfortune." At the time He Chong headed the Secretariat and held the law portfolio; censured, he maneuvered the next year into the Palace Secretariat to escape blame. That fourth month, on Bingwu, Venus occulted the Net's gap star. The omen read: "War will erupt." Another gloss adds: "The empress is imperiled." On Yimao in the sixth month, Venus trespassed the principal star of the Chariot Shaft. The omen read: "The palace mistress faces disaster." In the seventh year's third month Empress Du died. On Renwu in the third month of the seventh year, the Moon trespassed the Room. On Jichou in the fourth month, Venus entered the Ghost Wagon. In the fifth month Venus appeared in daytime. On Xinchou in the eighth month, the Moon trespassed the Ghost Wagon. In the eighth year's sixth month, Mars transgressed the second upper star of the Room. The omen read: "The junior minister faces peril." On Renyin in the eighth month, the Moon trespassed the Net. The omen read: "Subjects rebel against superiors and war follows." In the tenth month the Moon again occulted the Net's chief star. The prognostication matched the foregoing. That Jianyuan second year saw the death of Yu Bing, general of chariots and cavalry. Yu Yi mobilized a large force to strike Shi Hu, dominated the middle Yangzi, and alarmed the court.
27
康帝建元元年正月壬午，太白入昴。 占曰：「趙地有兵。 」又曰：「天下兵起。 」四月乙酉，太白晝見。 是年，石季龍殺其子邃，又遣將寇沒狄道，及屯薊東，謀慕容皝。 二年，歲星犯天關。 安西將軍庾翼與兄冰書曰：「歲星犯天關，占云關梁當分。 比來江東無他故，江道亦不艱難，而石季龍頻年再閉關，不通信使，此復是天公憒憒，無皁白之徵也。 」其閏月乙酉，太白犯斗。 占曰：「為喪，天下受爵祿。 」九月，帝崩，太子立，大赦，賜爵。
In the first year of Emperor Kang's Jianyuan era, on Renwu in the first month, Venus entered the Hairy Head. The omen read: "Armies in the Zhao region." Another line adds: "Warfare across the realm." On Yiyou in the fourth month, Venus showed by day. That year Shi Hu executed his heir Sui, sent columns to seize Didao, camped east of Ji, and menaced Murong Huang. In the second year Jupiter transgressed Heaven's Gate. Yu Yi, western pacification general, wrote his brother Bing that Jupiter at Heaven's Gate foretold severed passes and bridges. "East of the Yangzi all has been quiet and the waterway open, yet Shi Hu repeatedly sealed the passes and cut envoys; it is as if Heaven itself were confused and sent no clear sign." That intercalary month, on Yiyou, Venus trespassed the Dipper. The omen read: "Death in high places and empire-wide ennoblements." In the ninth month the emperor died, the crown prince succeeded, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and titles were granted.
28
穆帝永和元年正月丁丑，月入畢。 占曰：「兵大起。 」戊寅，月犯天關。 占曰：「有亂臣更天子之法。 」五月辛巳，太白晝見，在東井。 占曰：「為臣強，秦有兵。 」六月辛丑，月入太微，犯屏西南星。 占曰：「輔臣有免罷者。 」七月、八月，月皆犯畢。 占同上。 己未，月犯輿鬼。 占曰：「大臣有誅。 」九月庚戌，月又犯畢。 是年初，庾翼在襄陽。 七月，翼疾將終，輒以子爰之為荊州刺史，代己任。 爰之尋被廢。 明年，桓溫又輒率眾伐蜀，執李勢，送至京都。 蜀本秦地也。 二年二月壬子，月犯房上星。 四月丙戎，月又犯房上星。 八月壬申，太白犯左執法。 三年正月壬午，月犯南斗第五星。 占曰：「將軍死，近臣去。 」五月壬申，月犯南斗第四星，因入魁。 占曰：「有兵。 」一曰：「有大赦。 」六月，月犯東井距星。 占曰：「將軍死，國有憂。 」戍戌，月犯五諸侯。 占曰：「諸侯有誅。 」九月庚寅，太白犯南斗第五星。 占曰：「為喪，為兵。 」四年七月丙申，太白犯左執法。 甲寅，月犯房。 丁巳，月入南斗，犯第二星。 乙丑，太白犯左執法。 占悉同上。 十月甲辰，月犯亢。 占曰：「兵起，將軍死。 」十一月戊戌，月犯上將星。 三年六月，大赦。 是月，陳逵征壽春，敗而還。 七月，氐蜀餘寇反，亂益土。 九月，石季龍伐涼州。 五年，征北大將軍褚裒卒。 四年四月，太白入昴，是時，戎晉相侵，趙地連兵尤甚。 七月，太白犯軒轅。 占曰：「在趙，及為兵喪。 」甲寅，月犯房。 十月甲戊戌，月犯亢。 占曰：「兵起，將軍死。 」八月，石季龍太子宣殺弟韜，宣亦死。 其十一月戊戌，月犯上將星。 五年正月，石季龍僭號稱皇帝，尋死。 五年四月丁未，太白犯東井。 占曰：「秦有兵。 」九月戊戌，太白犯左角。 占曰：「為兵。 」十月，月犯昴。 占曰：「胡有憂，將軍死。 」是年八月，褚裒北征兵敗。 十月，關中二十餘舉兵內附。 石遵攻沒南陽。 十一月，冉閔殺石遵，又盡殺胡十餘萬人，於是趙魏大亂。 十二月，褚裒薨。 八年，劉顯、苻健、慕容雋並僭號。 殷浩北伐，敗績，見廢。 六年二月辛酉，月犯心大星。 占曰：「大人憂，又豫州分野也。 」丁丑，月犯房。 占曰：「將相憂。 」六月己丑月犯昴。 占同上。 乙未，月犯五諸侯。 占同上。 七月壬寅，月始出西方，犯左角。 占曰：「大將軍死。 」一曰：「天下有兵。 」丁未，月犯箕。 占曰：「將軍死。 」丙寅，熒惑犯鉞星。 占曰：「大臣有誅。 」八月辛卯，月犯左角。 太白晝見，在南斗。 月犯右執法。 占並同上。 是歲，司徒蔡謨免為庶人。 七年二月，太白犯昴。 占同上。 三月乙卯，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。 占曰：「貴人有憂。 」五月乙未，熒惑犯軒轅大星。 占曰：「女主憂。 」太白入畢口，犯左股。 占曰：「將相當之。 」六月乙亥，月犯箕。 占曰：「國有兵。 」丙子，月犯斗。 丁丑，熒惑入太微，犯右執法。 八月庚午，太白犯軒轅。 戊子，太白犯右執法。 占悉同上。 七年，劉顯殺石祗及諸將帥，山東大亂，疾疫死亡。 八年三月戊戌，月犯軒轅大星。 癸丑，月入南斗，犯第二星。 五月，月犯心星。 六月癸酉，月犯房。 七月壬子，歲星犯東井距星。 占曰：「內亂兵起。 」八月戊戌，熒惑入輿鬼。 占曰：忠臣戮死。 」丙辰，太白入南斗，犯第四星。 占曰：「將為亂。 」一曰：「丞相免。 」九年二月乙巳，月入南斗，犯第三星。 三月戊辰，月犯房。 八月，歲星犯輿鬼東南星。 占曰：「兵起。 」是時，帝幼沖，母后稱制，將相有隙，兵革連起，慕容雋僭號稱燕王，攻伐不休。 十年正月乙卯，月蝕昴星。 占曰：「趙魏有兵。 」癸酉，填星奄鉞星。 占曰：「斧鉞用。 」二月甲申，月犯心大星。 占曰：「王者惡之。 」七月庚午，太白晝見。 晷度推之，災在秦鄭。 九月辛酉，太白犯左執法。 是時，桓溫擅命，朝臣多見迫脅。 四月，溫伐苻健，破其嶢柳軍。 十二月，慕容恪攻齊。 十一年三月辛亥，月奄軒轅。 占同上。 四月庚寅，月犯牛宿南星。 占曰：「國有憂。 」八月己未，太白犯天江。 占曰：「河津不通。 」十二年六月庚子，太白晝見，在東井。 占如上。 己未，月犯鉞星。 八月癸酉，月奄建星。 九月戊寅，熒惑入太微，犯西蕃上將星。 十一月丁丑，熒惑犯太微東蕃上相星。 十二年十一月，齊城陷，執段龕，殺三千餘人。 永和三年，鮮卑侵略河、冀。 升平元年，慕容雋遂據臨漳，盡有幽、并、青、冀之地。 緣河諸將奔散，河津隔絕。 時權在方伯，九服交兵。
In the first year of Emperor Mu's Yonghe era, on Dingchou in the first month, the Moon entered the Net. The omen read: "Major mobilization." On Wuyin the Moon trespassed Heaven's Gate. The omen read: "Rebellious ministers who change the imperial statutes." On Xinsi in the fifth month, Venus appeared by day in the Eastern Well. The omen read: "Powerful ministers and armies in the Qin lands." On Xinchou in the sixth month, the Moon entered Supreme Subtlety and struck the southwest screen star. The omen read: "Senior aides will be cashiered." In the seventh and eighth months the Moon twice trespassed the Net. The gloss matched the prior entry. On Jiwei the Moon trespassed the Ghost Wagon. The omen read: "Great ministers face execution." On Gengxu in the ninth month the Moon again occulted the Net. Early that year Yu Yi held Xiangyang. In the seventh month, dying, Yu Yi named his son Yuanzhi Jingzhou inspector to succeed him. Yuanzhi was soon removed. The following year Huan Wen marched on Shu, captured Li Shi, and sent him to the capital. Shu had been heartland of Qin. On Renzi in the second month of the second year, the Moon trespassed the upper Room star. On Bingxu in the fourth month the Moon again struck the upper Room star. On Renshen in the eighth month, Venus transgressed Left Law Enforcement. On Renwu in the first month of the third year, the Moon trespassed the fifth star of the Southern Dipper. The omen read: "A general dies and inner-court favorites fall." On Renshen in the fifth month the Moon hit the Southern Dipper's fourth star and entered the bowl. The omen read: "War." Another gloss: "A great amnesty." In the sixth month the Moon occulted the Eastern Well's gap star. The omen read: "A general's death and national anxiety." On Wuxu the Moon trespassed the Five Feudal Lords. The omen read: "Regional lords face execution." On Gengyin in the ninth month, Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper's fifth star. The omen read: "Mourning and arms." On Bingshen in the seventh month of the fourth year, Venus trespassed Left Law Enforcement. On Jiayin the Moon trespassed the Room. On Dingsi the Moon entered the Southern Dipper and struck its second star. On Yichou, Venus transgressed Left Law Enforcement. Every gloss repeated the entries above. On Jiachen in the tenth month the Moon trespassed the Neck. The omen read: "War and a general's death." On Wuxu in the eleventh month the Moon struck the senior general star. The third year's sixth month brought a general amnesty. That month Chen Kui's Shouchun expedition failed and withdrew. In the seventh month Di and Shu raiders rose again and threw Shu commanderies into turmoil. In the ninth month Shi Hu invaded Liangzhou. In the fifth year northern expedition commander Chu Pou died. In the fourth year's fourth month Venus entered the Hairy Head while barbarians and Jin clashed, with heaviest fighting in the Zhao marches. In the seventh month Venus trespassed the Chariot Shaft. The omen read: "Disaster for Zhao: war and death." On Jiayin the Moon again trespassed the Room. On Jiaxu in the tenth month the Moon trespassed the Neck. The omen read: "War and a commander's end." In the eighth month Shi Hu's heir Shi Xuan murdered his brother Shi Tao and was himself killed. That November, on the Wuxu day, the Moon drew too near the star of the senior commander. In the first month of the fifth year, Shi Hu seized the imperial style and declared himself emperor, then died not long after. In the fourth month of the fifth year, on Dingwei, Venus trespassed against the Well asterism in the east. The prognostication reads that Qin would see armed conflict. On the Wuxu day of the ninth month, Venus closed on the left horn of the Azure Dragon. The omen was interpreted as widespread warfare. In the tenth month the Moon passed against the Pleiades lodge. The reading warned of trouble for the steppe peoples and the death of commanders. In the eighth month of the same year, Chu Pou's northern expedition met disaster. In the tenth month over twenty uprisings in Guanzhong yielded and came over to the court. Shi Zun took Nanyang by force. In the eleventh month Ran Min slew Shi Zun and massacred well over a hundred thousand Hu, throwing Zhao and the heartland into turmoil. Chu Pou passed away in the twelfth month. In the eighth year Liu Xian, Fu Jian, and Murong Jun each proclaimed illegitimate royal styles. Yin Hao's northern campaign collapsed and he was stripped of office. On Xinyou in the second month of the sixth year, the Moon crossed the chief star of the Heart mansion. The text foretold sorrow for high dignitaries and pointed to the celestial field of Yuzhou. On Dingchou the Moon impinged on the Room lodge. The omen spoke of danger to leading generals and ministers. On Jichou in the sixth month the Moon trespassed the Mao cluster. The prognostication matched the preceding gloss. On Yiwei the Moon neared the Five Feudal Lords stars. The same divinatory formula applied again. On Renyin in the seventh month, as the Moon first rose in the west it crossed the left horn. The reading predicted the death of a grand general. An alternate gloss warned of war throughout the realm. On Dingwei the Moon closed on the Winnowing-Basket stars. The omen indicated a general would perish. On Bingyin Mars drew near the axe-shaped star. The text foretold senior ministers facing capital punishment. On Xinmao in the eighth month the Moon crossed the left horn. Venus appeared in daylight within the Southern Dipper. The Moon passed against the right court official star in Supreme Palace. Every listed prognostication repeated the earlier ones. In the same year Minister over the Masses Cai Mo was degraded to commoner status. In the second month of the seventh year Venus crossed the Mao asterism. The divination matched the prior entry. On Yimao in the third month Mars entered the Ghost asterism and touched the Heap of Corpses. The gloss warned of misfortune for persons of high rank. On Yiwei in the fifth month Mars neared the chief star of the Coach constellation. The reading pointed to trouble for the empress or dowager. Venus entered the gap of the Net and crossed its left thigh star. The omen was said to fall on generals and ministers. On Yihai in the sixth month the Moon crossed the Winnowing-Basket. The text predicted internal or external war for the dynasty. On Bingzi the Moon trespassed the Dipper handle stars. On Dingchou Mars entered the Forbidden Enclosure and crossed the right court star. On Gengwu in the eighth month Venus brushed the Coach stars. On Wuzi Venus crossed the right Law-Enforcer. All associated prognostications repeated the same formulas. In the seventh year Liu Xian slew Shi Zhi and many generals; Shandong erupted in disorder with plague and heavy mortality. On Wuxu in the third month of the eighth year the Moon neared the chief Coach star. On Guichou the Moon entered the Dipper and crossed its second star. In the fifth month the Moon impinged on the Heart. On Guiyou in the sixth month the Moon crossed the Room lodge. On Renzi in the seventh month Jupiter passed the separator star of the Well. The reading warned of civil strife and mobilization. On Wuxu in the eighth month Mars entered the Ghost asterism. The gloss foretold loyal ministers being put to the sword. On Bingchen Venus entered the Dipper and crossed its fourth star. The omen warned that commanders would stir revolt. A variant reading predicted the chief minister would be removed. On Yisi in the second month of the ninth year the Moon entered the Dipper and crossed the third star. On Wuchen in the third month the Moon trespassed Room. In the eighth month Jupiter crossed the southeastern star of Ghost. The prognostication was simply that arms would rise. The throne was held by a child, the empress dowager ruled, factions split the high command, fighting spread without pause, Murong Jun styled himself king of Yan, and campaigns continued endlessly. On Yimao in the first month of the tenth year the Moon occulted a star in Mao. The text predicted warfare in the Zhao and Wei heartland sectors. On Guiyou Saturn passed over and hid the axe star. The reading pointed to executions and military justice. On Jiashen in the second month the Moon crossed the great Heart star. The omen was deemed ill for the sovereign. On Gengwu in the seventh month Venus shone in daylight. Shadow-length reckoning placed the disaster in the Qin and Zheng celestial fields. On Xinyou in the ninth month Venus crossed the left court star. Huan Wen dominated policy while numerous officials lived under duress. In the fourth month Huan Wen struck Fu Jian and routed the Yaoliu contingent. Murong Ke invaded Qi in the twelfth month. On Xinhai in the third month of the eleventh year the Moon passed over the Coach stars. The prognostication duplicated the earlier gloss. On Gengyin in the fourth month the Moon crossed the southern Ox star. The reading augured mourning or crisis for the realm. On Jiwei in the eighth month Venus crossed the Celestial River band. The omen warned that major crossings would be blocked. On Gengzi in the sixth month of the twelfth year Venus appeared by day within the Well. The divination matched those already cited. On Jiwei the Moon drew near the axe star. On Guiyou in the eighth month the Moon occulted a star of Establishment. On Wuyin in the ninth month Mars entered the Forbidden Enclosure and crossed the western senior commander star. On Dingchou in the eleventh month Mars crossed the eastern chief minister star of the enclosure. In the eleventh month of the twelfth year Qi fell, Duan Kan was captured, and over three thousand died. In the third year of Yonghe Xianbei forces harried the He and Ji corridors. In the first year of Shengping Murong Jun seized Linzhang and brought You, Bing, Qing, and Ji under his control. Riverine commanders fled in disorder and bridges and fords were severed. Real authority rested with regional governors while fighting spread across the subcelestial realm.
29
升平元年四月壬子，太白入輿鬼。 丁亥，月奄井南轅西頭第二星。 占曰：「秦地有兵。 」一曰：「將死。 」六月戊戌，太白晝見，在軫。 占同上。 軫是楚分野。 壬子，月犯畢。 占曰：「為邊兵。 」七月辛巳，熒惑犯天江。 占曰：「河津不通。 」十一月，歲星犯房。 占曰：「豫州有災。 」其年五月，苻堅殺苻生而立。 十二月，慕容雋入屯鄴。 二年八月，豫州刺史謝奕薨。 二年二月辛卯，填星犯軒轅大星。 占曰：「人主惡之。 」甲午，月犯東井。 六月辛酉，月犯房。 十月己未，太白犯哭星。 占曰：「有大哭泣。 」三年正月壬辰，熒惑犯楗閉星。 案占曰：「人主憂。 」三月乙酉，熒惑逆行犯鉤鈐。 案占：「王者惡之。 」六月，太白犯東井。 七月乙酉，熒惑犯天江。 丙戌，太白犯輿鬼。 占悉同上。 戊子，月犯牽牛中央大星。 占曰：「牽牛，天將也。 犯中央大星，將軍死。 」八月丁未，太白犯軒轅大星。 甲子，月犯畢大星。 占曰：「為邊兵。 」一曰：下犯上。 三年十月，諸葛恢舟軍入河，敗績。 豫州刺史謝萬入潁，眾潰而歸，萬除名。 十一月，司徒會稽王以郗曇、謝萬二鎮敗，求自敗，求自貶三等。 四年正月，慕容雋死，子暐代立。 慕容恪殺其尚書令陽騖等。 四年正月乙亥，月犯牽牛中央大星。 六月辛亥，辰星犯軒轅。 占曰：「女主憂。 」己未，太白入太微右掖門，從端門出。 占曰：「貴奪勢。 」一曰：「有兵。 」又曰：「出端門，臣不臣。 」八月戊申，太白犯氐。 占曰：「國有憂。 」丙辰，熒惑犯太微西蕃上將星。 九月壬午，太白入南斗口，犯第四星。 占曰：「為喪，有赦，天下受爵祿。 」十二月甲寅，熒惑犯房。 丙寅，太白晝見。 庚寅，月犯健閉，占曰：「人君惡之。 」五年正月乙巳，填星逆行，犯太微。 五月壬寅，月犯太微。 庚戌，月犯建星。 占曰：「大臣相謀。 」是時，殷浩敗績，卒致遷徙。 其月辛亥，月犯牽牛宿。 占曰：「國有憂。 」六月癸亥，月犯氐東北星。 占曰：「大將當之。 」五年正月，北中郎將郗曇薨。 五月，帝崩，哀帝立，大赦，賜爵，褚後失勢。 七月，慕容恪攻冀州刺史呂護于野王，護奔滎陽。 是時，桓溫以大眾次宛，聞護敗，乃退。 五年六月癸酉，月奄氐東北星。 占曰：「大將軍當之。 」九月乙酉，月奄畢。 占曰：「有邊兵。 」十月丁未，月犯畢大星。 占曰：「下犯上。 」又曰：「有邊兵。 」八月，范汪廢。 隆和元年，慕容暐遣將寇河陰。
On Renzi in the fourth month of Shengping year one Venus entered the Ghost asterism. On Dinghai the Moon covered the second star at the western end of the Well's southern shaft. The prognostication assigned armed trouble to the Qin field. A second reading predicted a general's death. In the sixth month, on Wuxu, Venus appeared in broad daylight within the Chariot asterism (Zhěn). The same omen gloss was applied as before. Zhěn marks Chu’s celestial field. On renzi the Moon crossed the Net (Bi) asterism. The omen-text reads: "Foretells frontier warfare." In the seventh month, on xinsi, Mars drew near the Celestial River. The gloss warns of blocked rivers and cut supply lines. In the eleventh month Jupiter crossed the House (Fang) mansion. The text points to disaster in the Yu region. That May, Fu Jian slew Fu Sheng and took the throne. In the twelfth month Murong Jun marched in and garrisoned Ye. In the second year’s eighth month, Yu provincial inspector Xie Yi passed away. On xinmao in the second month of the second year, Saturn crossed the chief star of Xuanyuan. The omen warns the sovereign of ill portent. On jiawu the Moon trespassed against the Eastern Well. On xinyou in the sixth month the Moon crossed the House mansion. In the tenth month, on jiwei, Venus closed on the Weeping star. The gloss foretells widespread mourning and lamentation. On renchen in the first month of the third year, Mars crossed the Gate-bolt stars. The commentary gloss reads: "The throne faces worry." On yiyou in the third month Mars moved retrograde against the Hook-and-Hasp. The omen-text says the ruler should dread the sign. In the sixth month Venus crossed the Eastern Well. On yiyou in the seventh month Mars again neared the Celestial River. On bingxu Venus crossed the Ghost asterism (Yuguǐ). Every cited gloss matched the entries above. On wuzi the Moon crossed the central bright star of the Oxherd. The text identifies the Oxherd as the celestial commander’s seat. A strike on its central star portends a field marshal’s death. On dingwei in the eighth month Venus crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star. On jiazi the Moon drew near the chief star of the Net. Again the gloss reads: "Border warfare." Another line adds: subordinates rise against superiors. That October Zhuge Hui’s flotilla pushed up the Yellow River and met disaster. Yu inspector Xie Wan marched into Yingzhou, his army routed; he returned in shame and lost his rank. In November the Prince of Kuaiji, serving as Minister of Education, cited Xi Tan and Xie Wan’s twin defeats and memorialized for a three-grade self-demotion. First month of the fourth year: Murong Jun died and his son Murong Wei inherited rule. Murong Ke executed Grand Secretary Yang Wu and associates. On yihai in the first month of the fourth year the Moon crossed the Oxherd’s central star. On xinhai in the sixth month Mercury crossed Xuanyuan. The gloss warns of trouble for the empress. On jiwei Venus slipped into the Supreme Palace through the right rear gate and left by the front portal. It portends great families stripped of influence. Another line adds armed conflict. A further gloss says leaving the Portal Gate marks ministers turning disloyal. On wushen in the eighth month Venus crossed the Root (Dǐ) stars. The realm faces mourning and worry. On bingchen Mars neared the western rampart’s senior commander star in the enclosure. On renwu in the ninth month Venus entered the Dipper’s mouth and struck its fourth star. It foretells funerals, a general pardon, and ennoblements across the land. On jiayin in the twelfth month Mars crossed the House mansion. On bingyin Venus shone in daylight. On gengyin the Moon crossed the Gate-bolt; the gloss warns the sovereign of dread. On yisi in the first month of the fifth year Saturn moved retrograde into the Supreme Palace. On renyin in the fifth month the Moon crossed the enclosure. On gengxu the Moon trespassed against the Establishment asterism. High officials are set to intrigue against each other. That season Yin Hao’s army was routed and he was eventually removed to the margins. That same month, on xinhai, the Moon crossed the Oxherd lodge. Again the gloss speaks of national mourning. On guihai in the sixth month the Moon covered the Root’s northeast star. A commander-in-chief will bear the brunt. First month of the fifth year: North-of-the-River general Xi Tan passed away. In May the sovereign died, Emperor Ai succeeded, a sweeping pardon was issued, titles were handed out, and Empress Chu was sidelined. In July Murong Ke besieged Ji inspector Lu Hu at Yewang, who bolted toward Xingyang. Huan Wen had massed troops at Wan; learning of Lu Hu’s rout, he pulled back. On guiyou in the fifth year’s sixth month the Moon occulted the Root’s northeast star. The omen again targets the commander-in-chief. On yiyou in the ninth month the Moon occulted the Net. Foretells frontier armies in motion. On dingwei in the tenth month the Moon crossed the Net’s chief star. Subordinates challenge their superiors. Another line repeats a border-war warning. In the eighth month Fan Wang was cashiered. Longhe year one: Murong Wei dispatched troops to strike Heyin.
30
哀帝興寧三年七月庚戌，月犯南斗。 占曰：「女主憂。 」歲星犯輿鬼。 占曰：「人君憂。 」十月，太白晝見，在亢。 占曰：「亢為朝廷，有兵喪，為臣強。 」明年五月，皇后庾氏崩。
Third Xingning year of Emperor Ai, seventh month, gengxu: the Moon crossed the Dipper. The empress faces ill portent. Jupiter crossed the Ghost asterism. The sovereign should brace for trouble. In the tenth month Venus appeared by day in the Neck (Kang). Kang marks the court: expect war, funerals, and overbearing ministers. The following May Empress Yu passed away.
31
海西太和二年正月，太白入昴。 五年，慕容暐為苻堅所滅，又據司、冀、幽、并四州。 六年閏月，熒惑守太微端門。 占曰：「天子亡國。 」又曰：「諸侯三公謀其上。 」一曰：「有斬臣。 」辛卯，月犯心大星。 占曰：「王者惡之。 」十一月，桓溫廢帝，並奏誅武陵王，簡文不許，溫乃徙之新安，皆臣強之應也。
First month of Taihe two under the deposed emperor: Venus entered the Pleiades lodge. By the fifth year Murong Wei had fallen to Fu Jian, who controlled Si, Ji, You, and Bing. The sixth year’s leap month saw Mars station at the enclosure’s Portal Gate. The gloss reads: the dynasty is lost. Another line warns that regional lords and chief ministers scheme against the throne. A variant adds executions among senior officials. On xinmao the Moon crossed Antares in the Heart. The sovereign should dread the sign. That November Huan Wen dethroned the sovereign and sought the Prince of Wuling’s death; Emperor Jianwen refused, so Wen banished the prince to Xin’an—classic signs of ministerial dominance.
32
簡文咸安元年十二月辛卯，熒惑逆行入太微，二年三月猶不退。 占曰：「國不安，有憂。 」是時，帝有桓溫之逼。 二年五月丁未，太白犯天關。 占曰：「兵起。 」歲星形色如太白。 占曰：「進退如度，奸邪息； 變色亂行，主無福。 歲星于仲夏當細小而不明，此其失常也。 又為臣強。 」六月，太白晝見，在七星。 乙酉，太白犯輿鬼。 占曰：「國有憂。 」七月，帝崩，桓溫以兵威擅權，將誅王坦之等，內外迫脅。 又，庾希入京城，盧悚入宮，並誅滅之。
Xian’an one, twelfth month, xinmao: Mars moved retrograde into the Supreme Palace and remained through the third month of year two. The realm stands unsettled under looming sorrow. The court lived under Huan Wen’s intimidation. On dingwei in the fifth month of the second year Venus crossed the Celestial Pass. The gloss reads: "Warfare will break out." Observers reported Jupiter’s hue and brilliance matching Venus. Another gloss reads: "When motion keeps proper measure, villainy subsides;" but shifting color and erratic motion leave the sovereign without fortune." At midsummer Jupiter should appear faint and small—its bright, Venus-like show was plainly abnormal. The same anomaly further signaled overbearing ministers. That June Venus shone by day among the Seven Stars (Sagittarius). On yiyou Venus crossed the Ghost asterism. The gloss warns of national mourning. In July the sovereign passed away while Huan Wen bullied the court with troops, poised to kill Wang Tanzhi and allies, tightening pressure inside the palace and out. Yu Xi marched on the capital and Lu Song burst into the palace; both risings were crushed.
33
孝武甯康元年正月戊申，月奄心大星。 案上曰：「災不在王者，則在豫州。 」一曰：「主命惡之。 」三月丙午，月奄南斗第五星。 占曰：「大臣憂，有死亡。 」一曰：「將軍死。 」七月，桓溫薨。 九月癸巳，熒惑入太微。 是時，女主臨朝，政事多缺。 二年閏月己未，月奄牽牛南星。 占曰：「左將軍死。 」十二月甲申，太白晝見，在氐。 氐，兗州分野。 三年五月丙午，北中郎將王坦之薨。 三年六月辛卯，太白犯東井。 占曰：「秦地有兵。 」九月戊申，熒惑奄左執法。 占曰：「執法者死。 」太元元年，苻堅破涼州。 二年十月，尚書令王彪之卒。 太元元年四月丙戌，熒惑犯南斗第三星。 丙申，又奄第四星。 占曰：「兵大起，中國饑。 」一曰：「有赦。 」八月癸酉，太白晝見，在氐。 氐，兗州分野。 九月，熒惑犯哭泣星，遂入羽林。 占曰：「天子有哭泣事，中軍兵起。 」十一月己未，月奄氐角。 占曰：「天下有兵。 」一曰：「國有憂。 」二年二月，熒惑守羽林。 占曰：「禁兵大起。 」九月壬午，太白晝見，在角。 角，兗州分野。 升平元年五月，大赦。 三年八月，秦人寇樊、鄧、襄陽、彭城。 四年二月，襄陽陷，朱序沒。 四月，魏興陷，賊聚廣陵、三河，眾五六萬。 於是諸軍外次沖要，丹陽尹屯衛京都。 六月，兗州刺史謝玄討賊，大破之。 是時，中外連兵，比年荒儉。 四年十一月丁巳，太白犯哭星。 占曰：「天子有哭泣事。 」五年七月丙子，辰星犯軒轅。 占曰：「女主當之。 」九月癸未，皇后王氏崩。 六年九月丙子。 太白晝見。 七年十一月，太白又晝見，在斗。 占曰：「吳有兵喪。 」八年四月甲子，太白又晝見，在參。 占曰：「魏有兵喪。 」是月，桓沖征沔漢，楊亮伐蜀，並拔城略地。 八月，苻堅自將，號百萬，九月，攻沒壽陽。 十月，劉牢之破苻堅將梁成，斬之，殺獲萬餘人。 謝玄等又破苻堅于淝水，斬其弟融，堅大眾奔潰。 九年六月，皇太后褚氏崩。 八月，謝玄出屯彭城，經略中州矣。 九年七月丙戌，太白晝見。 十一月丁巳，又晝見。 十年四月乙亥，又晝見於畢昴。 占曰：「魏國有兵喪。 」是時苻堅大眾奔潰，趙魏連兵相攻，堅為姚萇所殺。 十一年三月戊申，太白晝見，在東井。 占曰：「秦有兵，臣強。 」六月甲申，又晝見於輿鬼。 占曰：「秦有兵。 」時魏、姚萇、苻登連兵，相征不息。 甲午，歲星晝見，在胃。 占曰：「魯有兵，臣強。 」十二年，慕容垂寇東阿，翟遼寇河上，姚萇假號安定，苻登自立隴上，呂光竊據涼土。 十二年六月癸卯，太白晝見，在柳。 十月庚午，太白晝見，在斗。 十三年正月丙戌，又晝見。 十二月，熒惑在角亢，形色猛盛。 占曰：「熒惑失其常，吏且棄其法，諸侯亂其政。 」自是後，慕容垂、翟遼、姚萇、苻登、慕容永並阻兵爭強。 十四年正月，彭城妖賊又稱號於皇丘，劉牢之破滅之。 三月，張道破合鄉，圍泰山，向欽之擊走之。 是年，翟遼又攻沒滎陽，侵略陳項。 于時政事多弊，君道陵遲矣。 十四年四月乙巳，太白晝見於柳。 六月辛卯，又晝見於翼。 九月丙寅，又晝見於軫。 十二月，熒惑入羽林。 占並同上。 十五年，翟遼掠司兗，眾軍累討不克，慕容垂又跨略并、冀等州。 七月，旱。 八月，諸郡大水，兗州又蝗。 十五年九月癸未，熒惑入太微。 十月，太白入羽林。 十六年四月癸卯朔，太白晝見。 十一月癸巳，月奄心前星。 占曰：「太子憂。 」是時，太子常有篤疾。 十七年七月丁丑，太白晝見。 十月丁酉，又晝見。 十八年六月，又晝見。 十九年五月，又晝見於柳。 六月辛酉，又晝見於輿鬼。 九月，又見於軫。 二十年六年，熒惑入天囷。 占曰：「大饑。 」七月丁亥，太白晝見，在太微。 占曰：「太白入太微，國有憂。 晝見為兵喪。 」十二月己巳，月犯楗閉及東西咸。 占曰：「楗閉司心腹喉舌，東西咸主陰謀。 」二十一年二月壬申，太白晝見。 三月癸卯，太白連晝見，在羽林。 占曰：「有強臣，有兵喪，中軍兵起。 」三月，太白晝見於胃。 占曰：「中軍兵起。 」四月壬午，太白入天囷。 占曰：「為饑。 」六月，歲星犯哭泣星。 占曰：「有哭泣事。 」是年九月，帝崩。 隆安元年，王恭等舉兵脅朝廷，於是內外戒嚴，殺王國寶以謝之。 又連歲水旱，三方動，眾人饑。
Ningkang one, first month, wushen: the Moon occulted Antares. Commentary notes: if the throne escapes harm, Yu region still bears the blow. Another line warns the sovereign’s life-omen turns ill. On bingwu in the third month the Moon occulted the Dipper’s fifth star. Senior officials face mourning and fatalities. A variant singles out a field commander’s death. Huan Wen died in the seventh month. On guisi in the ninth month Mars entered the Supreme Palace. The regent empress held court while administration faltered. Leap month of year two, jiwei: the Moon occulted the Oxherd’s southern star. Foretells the death of the left-side commander. Twelfth month, jiashen: Venus shone by day in the Root (Dǐ). Dǐ marks Yanzhou’s celestial territory. Third year, fifth month, bingwu: North-of-the-River general Wang Tanzhi passed away. Sixth month, xinmao: Venus crossed the Eastern Well. Foretells warfare in the old Qin heartland. Ninth month, wushen: Mars occulted the Left Law Enforcer star. Judicial officials face execution or death. Taiyuan one: Fu Jian conquered Liangzhou. Second year’s tenth month: chief minister Wang Biaozhi died. Taiyuan one, fourth month, bingxu: Mars crossed the Dipper’s third star. On bingshen Mars also occulted the fourth star. Mass mobilization and famine stalk the heartland. Another line allows for a general pardon. Eighth month, guiyou: Venus appeared by day in the Root. Again Dǐ ties the sign to Yanzhou. September: Mars crossed the Weeping star and marched into the Feathered Forest guard asterism. Royal mourning and palace-guard mobilization follow. Eleventh month, jiwei: the Moon occulted the Root’s horn. War spreads across the realm. Another gloss stresses national mourning. Second year, second month: Mars stationed in the Feathered Forest. Elite household regiments swell in mutiny or campaign. Ninth month, renwu: Venus shone by day in the Horn. The Horn marks Yanzhou’s field. Shengping one, fifth month: a sweeping pardon. Third year, eighth month: Former Qin forces hit Fan, Deng, Xiangyang, and Pengcheng. Fourth year, second month: Xiangyang fell; Zhu Xu was taken. April: Weixing collapsed; rebels massed fifty to sixty thousand between Guangling and the Sanhe region. Imperial columns sealed the passes while the Danyang governor fortified the approaches to the capital. June: Yan inspector Xie Xuan smashed the rebel host. Civil war raged on all sides amid successive famines. Fourth year, eleventh month, dingsi: Venus crossed the Weeping star. Royal tears and state funerals were portended. Fifth year, seventh month, bingzi: Mercury crossed Xuanyuan. The empress bears the omen. September, guiwei: Empress Wang passed away. Sixth year, ninth month, bingzi (date anchor). Venus shone in daylight. Seventh year, eleventh month: Venus reappeared by day in the Dipper. The southeast (Wu lands) faces war and funerals. Eighth year, fourth month, jiazi: Venus again shone by day in Orion. The heartland Wei zone faces battle and bereavement. That same month Huan Chong drove up the Han while Yang Liang struck Shu; both columns took towns and ground. August: Fu Jian took the field at the head of a host styled a million; September saw Shouyang fall. October: Liu Laozhi routed Liang Cheng, Fu Jian’s general, took his head, and piled up over ten thousand casualties and captives. Xie Xuan’s coalition broke Fu Jian on the Fei, slew his brother Fu Rong, and scattered the mass army. Ninth year, June: Empress Dowager Chu died. August: Xie Xuan advanced to garrison Pengcheng, eyeing the Central Plain. Ninth year, seventh month, bingxu: Venus by day. Eleventh month, dingsi: another daylight Venus. Tenth year, fourth month, yihai: Venus again blazed by day through Bi and the Pleiades. The Wei heartland faces war and death. Fu Jian’s army had melted away; northern rivals tore at each other until Yao Chang slew Fu Jian. Eleventh year, third month, wushen: Venus by day in the Eastern Well. Qin lands see war and domineering ministers. Sixth month, jiashen: daylight Venus in the Ghost asterism. Again: warfare in Qin. Wei, Yao Chang, and Fu Deng kept armies in the field without pause. Jiawu: Jupiter shone by day in the Stomach lodge. Lu’s territory faces war; ministers grow overbearing. Twelfth year: Murong Chui struck Dong’e, Zhai Liao harried the He frontier, Yao Chang styled himself at Anding, Fu Deng held Long, and Lü Guang carved out Liangzhou. Twelfth year, sixth month, guimao: Venus by day in the Willow. Tenth month, gengwu: daylight Venus in the Dipper. Thirteenth year, first month, bingxu: another daylight Venus. December: Mars blazed angrily through Horn and Neck. Erratic Mars means collapsing bureaucracy and rebel barons. Afterward Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, and Murong Yong all kept private armies and fought for dominance. Fourteenth year, first month: Pengcheng rebels styled themselves at Huangqiu until Liu Laozhi wiped them out. March: Zhang Dao took Hexiang and ringed Taishan until Xiang Qinzhi repulsed him. That year Zhai Liao seized Xingyang and scourged Chen and Xiang. Administration rotted while royal authority slid. Fourteenth year, fourth month, yisi: Venus by day in the Willow. Sixth month, xinmao: daylight Venus in the Wings. September, bingyin: daylight Venus in the Chariot. December: Mars entered the Feathered Forest. The glosses matched those cited earlier. Fifteenth year: Zhai Liao raided Si and Yan while imperial columns failed to finish him; Murong Chui meanwhile overran Bing and Ji. July brought drought. August floods swamped the districts and locusts scourged Yanzhou. Fifteenth year, September, guiwei: Mars entered the Supreme Palace. October: Venus marched into the Feathered Forest. Sixteenth year, fourth month, guimao new moon: Venus visible by day. Eleventh month, guisi: the Moon occulted the Heart’s forward star. The gloss warns of peril to the crown prince. The heir was chronically and gravely ill. Seventeenth year, seventh month, dingchou: Venus by day. Tenth month, dingyou: another daylight Venus. Eighteenth year, sixth month: Venus again shone by day. Nineteenth year, May: daylight Venus in the Willow. June, xinyou: daylight Venus in the Ghost asterism. September: Venus reappeared in the Chariot. Twentieth year, sixth month: Mars entered the Celestial Granary (Heaven’s round-silo asterism). The omen reads: widespread starvation. July, dinghai: Venus blazed by day inside the Supreme Palace. Venus inside the enclosure spells national mourning. Daylight appearance adds war and funerals. December, jisi: the Moon crossed the Gate-bolt and the east and west Sincerity stars. The bolt-stars watch intimates and spokesmen; the Sincerity pair marks hidden intrigue. Twenty-first year, second month, renshen: Venus by day. March, guimao: Venus lingered visible by day in the Feathered Forest. Foretells a domineering minister, battle and bereavement, and palace-army upheaval. March: daylight Venus in the Stomach lodge. Household guards mobilize. April, renwu: Venus entered the Celestial Granary. Portends hunger. June: Jupiter crossed the Weeping star. Mourning follows. That September the sovereign died. Long’an one: Wang Gong’s coalition menaced Jiankang; the capital locked down and Wang Guobao was executed as a sop. Years of weather disaster roiled three war zones while commoners went hungry.
34
安帝隆安元年正月癸亥，熒惑犯哭泣星。 占曰：「有哭泣事。 」四月丁丑，太白晝見，在東井。 占曰：「秦有兵喪。 」六月，姚興攻洛陽，郗恢遣兵救之。 冬姚萇死，子略代立。 魏王圭即位於中山。 其八月，熒惑守井鉞。 占曰：「大臣有誅。 」二年六月戊辰，攝提移度失常。 歲星晝見，在胃，兗州分野。 是年六月，郗恢遣鄭啟方等以萬人伐慕容寶於滑臺，敗而還。 閏月，太白晝見，在羽林。 丁丑，月犯東上相。 三年五月辛酉，月又奄東上相。 辛未，辰星犯軒轅大星。 占悉同上。 二年九月，庾楷等舉兵，表誅王愉等，於是內外戒嚴。 三年六月，洛陽沒於冠。 桓玄破荊州，雍州殺殷仲堪等。 孫恩聚眾攻沒會稽，殺內史。 四年六月辛酉，月犯哭泣星。 五年正月，太白晝見。 自去年十二月在斗晝見，至於是月乙卯。 案占：「災在吳越。 」七月癸亥，大角星散搖五色。 占曰：「王者流散。 」丁卯，月犯天關。 占曰：「王者憂。 」九月庚子，熒惑犯少微，又守之。 占曰：「處士誅。 」十月甲子，月犯東次相。 其年七月，太皇太后李氏崩。 十月，妖賊大破高雅之于餘姚，死者十七八。 五年，孫恩攻侵郡縣，殺內史，至京口，進軍蒲洲，於是內外戒嚴。 恩遣別將攻廣陵，殺三千餘人，退據郁洲，是時劉裕又追破之。 九月，桓玄表至，逆旨陵上。 十月，司馬元顯大治水軍，將以伐玄。 元興元年正月，盧循自稱征虜將軍，領孫恩餘眾，略有永嘉、晉安之地。 二月，帝戎服遣西軍。 三月，桓玄，克京都，殺司馬元顯，放太傅會稽王道子。
Long’an one, first month, guihai: Mars crossed the Weeping star. Again: royal mourning. April, dingchou: Venus by day in the Eastern Well. The northwestern Qin theater faces war and death. June: Yao Xing struck Luoyang while Xi Hui dispatched relief. Winter: Yao Chang died and his son Yao Xing (Lie) took the throne. Wei prince Tuoba Gui mounted the throne at Zhongshan. That August Mars stationed at the Eastern Well’s axe stars. Senior officials face execution. Second year, sixth month, wuchen: the Sheti pointer jumped its proper step. Jupiter shone by day in the Stomach, Yanzhou’s celestial field. That June Xi Hui sent Zheng Qifang’s ten-thousand-man column against Murong Bao at Huatai; it retreated in defeat. Leap month: daylight Venus in the Feathered Forest. Dingchou: the Moon crossed the eastern upper minister star. Third year, May, xinyou: the Moon again occulted the eastern upper minister. Xinwei: Mercury crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star. The glosses matched prior entries. Second year, September: Yu Kai’s faction mobilized to demand Wang Yu’s head; the realm went on war footing. Third year, June: Luoyang was lost to raiders. Huan Xuan shattered Jingzhou while Yongzhou forces slew Yin Zhongkan and his circle. Sun En’s rebels seized Kuaiji and executed the governor. Fourth year, June, xinyou: the Moon crossed the Weeping star. Fifth year, first month: Venus by day. Since the prior twelfth month Venus had stayed visible by day in the Dipper until yimao of this month. Commentary places the omen in the Wu-Yue southeast. July, guihai: Arcturus flickered in polychrome bursts. Portends a sovereign driven from his throne. Dingmao: the Moon crossed the Celestial Pass. Royal worry is foretold. September, gengzi: Mars crossed Shao Wei and stationed there. Hermit-scholars face the headsman. October, jiazi: the Moon crossed the eastern secondary minister. That July Grand Empress Dowager Li passed away. October: rebel sorcerers shattered Gao Yazhi at Yuyao with seventy to eighty percent losses. Fifth year: Sun En raided commanderies, slew governors, pushed to Jingkou and Pu Islet, and put the capital region on alert. Sun En’s column hit Guangling, killed three thousand-plus, then fell back to Yuzhou island until Liu Yu chased and crushed them. September: Huan Xuan’s arrogant memorial snubbed the throne. October: Sima Yuanxian mass-trained a fleet to strike Huan Xuan. Yuanxing one, first month: Lu Xun claimed the caitiff-subduing generalship, inherited Sun En’s bands, and carved out Yongjia and Jin’an. February: the emperor, in armor, sent the western host. March: Huan Xuan seized Jiankang, executed Sima Yuanxian, and exiled Prince Daozi of Kuaiji.
35
元興元年三月戊子，太白犯五諸侯，因晝見。 占曰：「諸侯有誅。 」七月戊寅，熒惑在東井。 熒惑犯輿鬼、積尸。 占並同上。 八月丙寅，太白奄右執法。 九月癸未，太白犯進賢。 占曰：「進賢者誅。 」二年二月，歲星犯西上將。 六月甲辰，月奄斗第四星。 占曰：「大臣誅，不出三年。 」八月癸丑，太白犯房北第二星。 九月己丑，歲星犯進賢，熒惑犯西上將。 十月甲戌，太白犯泣星。 十一月丁酉，熒惑犯東上相。 十二月乙巳，月奄軒轅第二星。 占悉同上。 元年冬，魏破姚興軍。 二年十二月，桓玄篡位，放遷帝、後於尋陽，以永安何皇后為零陵君。 三年二月，劉裕盡誅桓氏。 三年正月戊戌，熒惑逆行，犯太微西上相。 占曰：「天子戰于野，上相死。 」二月丙辰，熒惑逆行，在左執法西北。 占曰：「執法者誅。 」四月甲午，月奄軒轅第二星。 五月壬申，月奄斗第二星，填星入羽林。 占並同上。 是年二月丙辰，劉裕殺桓修等。 三月己末，破走桓玄，遣軍西討。 辛巳，誅左僕射王愉，桓玄劫天子如江陵。 五月，玄下至崢嶸洲，義軍破滅之。 桓振又攻沒江陵，幽劫天子。 七月，永安何皇后崩。
Yuanxing one, third month, wuzi: Venus crossed the Five Feudal Lords and shone by day. Regional lords face execution. July, wuyin: Mars stood in the Eastern Well. Mars crossed the Ghost asterism and the corpse-pile stars. Glosses repeated earlier lines. August, bingyin: Venus occulted the right Law Enforcer. September, guiwei: Venus crossed the Advancing Worthy star. Men tied to the Advancing Worthy star face death. Second year, February: Jupiter crossed the western upper general. June, jiachen: the Moon occulted the Dipper’s fourth star. High ministers die, within three years’ span. August, guichou: Venus crossed the Chamber’s second north star. September, jichou: Jupiter crossed Advancing Worthy while Mars crossed the western upper general. October, jiaxu: Venus crossed the Weeping star. November, dingyou: Mars crossed the eastern upper minister. December, yisi: the Moon occulted Xuanyuan’s second star. Omen glosses matched prior citations. First year winter: Northern Wei shattered Yao Xing’s host. Second year, twelfth month: Huan Xuan seized the throne, exiled the sovereigns to Xunyang, and demoted Empress He to Lady of Lingling. Third year, February: Liu Yu wiped out the Huans. Third year, first month, wuxu: Mars moved retrograde against the enclosure’s western upper minister. Portends a ruler fighting in the open and a chief minister’s death. February, bingchen: Mars hung retrograde northwest of the Left Law Enforcer. Judicial stars mark executions.
