April, jiawu: the Moon occulted Xuanyuan’s second star. May, renshen: the Moon occulted the Dipper’s second star while Saturn entered the Feathered Forest. Glosses again matched earlier ones. That February, bingchen, Liu Yu slew Huan Xiu and associates. March, jiwei: Liu Yu broke Huan Xuan and launched western pursuit columns. Xinsi: Wang Yu the left director was beheaded while Huan Xuan abducted the emperor toward Jiangling. May: Huan Xuan descended to Zhengrong Islet where the loyalist host annihilated him. Huan Zhen retook Jiangling, holding the emperor captive. July: Empress He of Yong’an passed away.
36
義熙元年三月壬辰，月奄左執法。 占同上。 丁酉，月奄心前星。 占曰：「豫州有災」。 太白犯東井。 占曰：「秦有兵。 」七月庚辰，太白晝見，在翼、軫。 占曰：「為臣強，荊州有兵喪。 」八月丁巳，月犯斗第一星。 占曰：「天下有兵。 」一曰：「大臣憂。 」九月甲子，熒惑犯少微。 占曰：「處士誅。 」庚寅，熒惑犯右執法。 癸卯，熒惑犯左執法。 占並同上。 十一月丙戌，太白犯鉤鈐。 占曰：「喉舌憂。 」十二月己卯，歲星犯天江。 占曰：「有兵亂，河津不通。 」十一月，荊州刺史魏詠之薨。 二年二月，司馬國璠等攻沒弋陽。 四月，姚興伐仇池公楊盛，擊走之。 九月，益州刺史司馬榮期為其參軍楊承祖所害。 三年十二月，司徒揚州刺史王謐薨。 四年正月，太保武陵王遵薨。 三月，左僕射孔安國卒。 自後政在劉裕，人主端拱而已。 二年二月，太白犯南斗。 占曰：「兵起。 己丑，月犯心後星。 占曰：「豫州有災。 」四月癸丑，月犯太微西上將。 己未，月犯房南第二星。 乙丑，歲星犯天江。 占曰：「有兵亂，河津不通。 」五月癸未，月犯左角。 占曰：「左將軍死，天下有兵。 」壬寅，熒惑犯氐。 占曰：「氐為宿宮，人主憂。 」六月庚午，熒惑犯房北第二星。 八月癸亥，熒惑犯南斗第五星。 丁巳，犯建星。 占曰：「為兵。 」九月壬午，熒惑犯哭星，又犯泣星。 是年二月甲戌，司馬國璠等攻沒弋陽。 又，慕容超侵略徐、兗，三年正月，又寇北徐州，至下邳。 十二月，司徒王謐薨。 四年正月，武陵王遵薨。 五年，慕容超復寇淮北。 四月，劉裕大軍討之，拔臨朐。 又圍廣固拔之。 三年正月丙子，太白晝見，在奎。 二月庚申，月奄心後星。 占同上。 五月癸未，月犯左角。 己丑，太白晝見，在參。 占曰：「益州有兵喪，臣強。 」八月己卯，太白犯左執法。 辛卯，熒惑犯左執法。 九月壬子，熒惑犯進賢星。 是年八月，劉敬宣伐蜀，不克而旋。 四年三月，左僕射孔安國卒。 七月，司馬叔璠等攻沒鄒山，魯郡太守徐邕破走之。 姚略遣眾征赫連勃勃，大為所破。 五年，劉裕討慕容超，滅之。 四年正月庚子，熒惑犯天關。 五月丁未，月奄斗第二星。 壬子，填星犯天廩。 占曰：「天下饑，倉粟少。 」六月己丑，太白犯太微西上將。 乙卯又犯左執法。 十月戊子，熒惑入羽林。 占悉同上。 五年，劉裕討慕容超，後南北軍旅運轉不息。 五年二月甲子，月犯昴。 占曰：「胡不安，天子破匈奴。 」五月戊戌，歲星入羽林。 九月壬寅，月犯昴。 十月，熒惑犯氐。 閏月丁酉，月犯昴。 辛亥，熒惑犯鉤鈐。 己巳，月奄心大星。 占曰：「王者惡之。 」是年四月，劉裕討慕容超。 十月，魏王圭遇弑殂。 六年五月，盧循逼郊甸，宮衛被甲。 六年三月丁卯，月奄房南第二星。 災在次相。 己巳，又奄斗第五星。 占曰：「斗主吳，吳地兵起。 」太白犯五諸侯。 占曰：「諸侯有誅。 」五月甲子，月奄斗第五星。 己亥，月奄昴第三星。 占曰：「國有憂。 」一曰：「有白衣之會。 」六月己丑，月犯房南第二星。 甲午，太白晝見。 七月己亥，月犯輿鬼。 占曰：「國有憂。 」一曰：「秦有兵。 八月壬午，太白犯軒轅大星。 甲申，月犯心前星。 災在豫州。 丙戌，月犯斗第五星。 占同上。 丁亥，月奄牛宿南星。 占曰：「天下有大誅。 」乙未，太白犯少微。 丙午，太白在少微而晝見。 九月甲寅，太白犯左執法。 丁丑，填星犯畢。 占曰：「有邊兵。 」是年三月，始興太守徐道覆反。 四月，盧循寇湘中，沒巴陵，率眾逼京畿。 是月，左僕射孟昶懼王威不振，仰藥自殺。 七年十二月，劉蕃梟徐道覆首，杜慧度斬盧循，並傳首京都。 八年六月，劉道規卒，時為豫州刺史。 八月，皇后王氏崩。 九月，兗州刺史劉蕃、尚書左僕射謝混伏誅。 劉裕西討劉毅，斬首徇之。 十二月，遣益州刺史朱齡石伐蜀。 七年四月辛丑，熒惑入輿鬼。 占曰：「秦有兵。 」一曰：「雍州有災。 」六月，太白晝見，在翼。 己亥，填星犯天關。 占曰：「臣謀主。 」八月，太白犯房南第二星。 十一月丙子，太白犯哭星。 其七月，朱齡石克蜀。 蜀又反，討滅之。 八年七月癸亥，月奄房北第二星。 己未，月犯井鉞。 八月戊申，月犯泣星。 十月辛亥，月奄天關。 占曰：「有兵。 」十一月丁丑，填星犯東井。 占曰：「大人憂。 」十二月癸卯，填星犯井鉞。 是年八月，皇后王氏崩。 九月，誅劉蕃、謝混，討滅劉毅。 十二月，朱齡石滅蜀。 九年二月，熒惑入輿鬼。 占曰：「有兵喪。 」太白犯南河。 占曰：「兵起。 」五月壬辰，太白犯右執法，晝見。 七月庚午，月奄鉤鈐。 占曰：「喉舌臣憂。 」九月庚午，歲星犯軒轅大星。 己丑，月犯左角。 時劉裕擅命，兵革不休。 十年，裕討司馬休之。 王師不利，休之等奔長安。 十年正月丁卯，月犯畢。 占曰：「將相有以象坐罪者。 」二月己酉，月犯房北星。 五月壬寅，月犯牽牛南星。 乙丑，歲星犯軒轅大星。 占悉同上。 六月丙申，月奄氐。 占曰：「將死之，國有誅者。 」七月庚辰，月犯天關。 占曰：曰：「兵起。 」熒惑犯井鉞。 填星犯輿鬼，遂守之。 占曰：「大人憂，宗廟改。 」八月丁酉，月奄牽牛南星。 占同上。 九月，填星犯輿鬼。 占曰：「人主憂。 」丁巳，太白入羽林。 十二月己酉，月犯西咸。 占曰：「有陰謀。 」十一年，林邑冠交州，距敗之。 十一年三月丁巳，月入畢。 占曰：「天下兵起。 」一曰：「有邊兵。 」己卯，熒惑入輿鬼。 閏月丙午，填星又入輿鬼。 占曰：「為旱，大疫，為亂臣。 」五月癸卯，熒惑入太微。 甲辰，犯右執法。 六月己未，太白犯東井。 占曰：「秦有兵。 」戊寅，犯輿鬼。 占曰：「國有憂。 」七月辛丑，月犯畢。 占同上。 八月壬子，月犯氐。 占同上。 庚申，太白順行，從右掖門入太微。 丁卯，奄左執法。 十一月癸亥，月入畢。 占同上。 乙未，月入輿鬼而暈。 十二年五月甲申，歲星留房心之間，宋之分野。 始封劉裕為宋公。 六月壬子，太白順行入太微右掖門。 己巳，月犯畢。 占同上。 七月，月犯牛宿。 十月丙戌，月入畢。 十三年五月丙子，月犯軒轅。 丁亥，犯牽牛。 癸巳，熒惑犯右執法。 八月己酉，月犯牽牛。 丁卯，月犯太微。 占曰：「人君憂。 」九月壬辰，熒惑犯軒轅。 十月戊申，月犯畢。 占悉同上。 月犯箕。 占曰：「國有憂。 」甲寅，月犯畢。 占同上。 乙卯，填星犯太微，留積七十餘日。 占曰：「亡君之戒。 」壬戌，月犯太微。 十四年三月癸巳，太白犯五諸侯。 五月庚子，月犯太微。 七月甲辰，熒惑犯輿鬼。 占曰：「秦有兵，又為旱，為兵喪。 」亦曰：「大人憂，宗廟改，亦為亂臣。 」時劉裕擅命，軍旅數興，饑旱相屬，其後卒移晉室。 丁巳，月犯東井。 占曰：「軍將死。 」八月甲子，太白犯軒轅。 癸酉，填星入太微，犯右執法，因留太微中，積二百餘日乃去。 占曰：「填星守太微，亡君之戒，有徙王。 九月乙未，太白入太微，犯左執法。 丁巳，月入太微。 占曰：「大人憂。 」十月甲申，月入太微。 癸巳，熒惑入太微，犯西蕃上將，仍順行，至左掖門內，留二十日，乃逆行。 義熙十二年七月，劉裕伐姚泓。 十三年八月，禽姚泓，司、兗、秦、雍悉平。 十四年，劉裕還彭城，受宋公。 十一月，左僕射前將軍劉穆之卒。 明年，西虜寇長安，雍州刺史朱齡石諸軍陷沒，官軍舍而東。 十二月，帝崩。
Yixi one, third month, renchen: the Moon occulted the Left Law Enforcer. The same gloss applied. Dingyou: the Moon occulted the Heart’s forward star. The omen targets Yu region. Venus crossed the Eastern Well. Foretells Qin-zone warfare. July, gengchen: Venus shone by day through Wings and Chariot. Powerful ministers and Jingzhou war and funerals. August, dingsi: the Moon crossed the Dipper’s first star. General war spreads. Senior officials face sorrow. September, jiazi: Mars crossed Shao Wei. Hermit scholars face execution. Gengyin: Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer. Guimao: Mars crossed the Left Law Enforcer. Glosses matched prior entries. November, bingxu: Venus crossed the Hook-and-Hasp. Spokesmen and advisors face ruin. December, jimao: Jupiter crossed the Celestial River. War chaos chokes the waterways. November: Jing inspector Wei Yongzhi passed away. Second year, February: Sima Guofan’s faction seized Yiyang. April: Yao Xing struck Yang Sheng of Chouchi and repulsed him. September: Yi inspector Sima Rongqi fell to adjutant Yang Chengzu’s blade. Third year, December: Wang Mi, Minister of Education and Yangzhou inspector, died. Fourth year, first month: Grand Guardian Prince Zun of Wuling died. March: Left Director Kong Anguo passed away. Afterward real power sat with Liu Yu while the emperor ruled in name only. Second year, February: Venus crossed the Southern Dipper. War stirs. Jichou: the Moon crossed the Heart’s rear star. Yu region again bears the omen. April, guichou: the Moon crossed the enclosure’s western upper general. Jiwei: the Moon crossed the Chamber’s second south star. Yichou: Jupiter crossed the Celestial River. River blockages and mutiny follow. May, guiwei: the Moon crossed the Horn’s left star. The left commander dies while war engulfs the realm. Renyin: Mars crossed the Root. The Root as palace seat means the sovereign faces dread. June, gengwu: Mars crossed the Chamber’s second north star. August, guihai: Mars crossed the Dipper’s fifth star. Dingsi: Mars crossed the Establishment asterism. Plain war omen. September, renwu: Mars crossed both Weeping and Sobbing stars. That February, jiaxu, Sima Guofan again seized Yiyang. Murong Chao harried Xu and Yan; third year’s first month he struck Northern Xu as far as Xiapi. December: Minister Wang Mi died. Fourth year, first month: Prince Zun of Wuling passed away. Fifth year: Murong Chao returned to scour the north of the Huai. April: Liu Yu’s host took Linqu. He then ringed and stormed Guanggu. Third year, first month, bingzi: Venus by day in the Strider (Kui). February, gengshen: the Moon occulted the Heart’s rear star. Same gloss as prior Heart omen. May, guiwei: the Moon crossed the left Horn. Jichou: Venus shone by day in Orion’s Belt. Yi region faces war and death while ministers grow bold. August, jimao: Venus crossed the Left Law Enforcer. Xinmao: Mars crossed the Left Law Enforcer. September, renzi: Mars crossed Advancing Worthy. That August Liu Jingxuan’s Shu expedition failed and turned back. Fourth year, March: Left Director Kong Anguo died. July: Sima Shufan seized Zou Mountain until Lu governor Xu Yong routed the band. Yao Xing’s army marched on Helian Bobo and was shattered. Fifth year: Liu Yu crushed Murong Chao. Fourth year, first month, gengzi: Mars crossed the Celestial Pass. May, dingwei: the Moon occulted the Dipper’s second star. Renzi: Saturn crossed the Celestial Granary. Famine empties the state granaries. June, jichou: Venus crossed the western upper general. Yimao: Venus also crossed the Left Law Enforcer. October, wuzi: Mars entered the Feathered Forest. Glosses repeated earlier citations. Fifth year: Liu Yu’s Murong campaign kept north-south logistics in perpetual motion. Fifth year, second month, jiazi: the Moon crossed the Pleiades. Steppe peoples tremble while the court crushes northern raiders. May, wuxu: Jupiter entered the Feathered Forest. September, renyin: the Moon crossed the Pleiades. October: Mars crossed the Root. Leap month, dingyou: the Moon crossed the Pleiades. Xinhai: Mars crossed the Hook-and-Hasp. Jisi: the Moon occulted Antares. The sovereign should dread the sign. That April Liu Yu opened the Murong Chao campaign. October: Wei prince Tuoba Gui was murdered. Sixth year, May: Lu Xun threatened the capital outskirts and household troops armed. Sixth year, third month, dingmao: the Moon occulted the Chamber’s second south star. The omen falls on the deputy minister. Jisi: the Moon again occulted the Dipper’s fifth star. The Dipper ties the sign to Wu and southeast warfare. Venus crossed the Five Feudal Lords. Regional lords face execution. May, jiazi: the Moon occulted the Dipper’s fifth star. Jihai: the Moon occulted the Pleiades’ third star. National mourning follows. Another line warns of mass mourning in undyed hemp. June, jichou: the Moon crossed the Chamber’s second south star. Jiawu: Venus shone by day. July, jihai: the Moon crossed the Ghost asterism. National mourning is foretold. Another gloss cites Qin-region warfare. August, renwu: Venus crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star. Jiashen: the Moon crossed the Heart’s forward star. The blow falls on Yu region. Bingxu: the Moon crossed the Dipper’s fifth star. Same gloss as the prior Dipper omen. Dinghai: the Moon occulted the Ox lodge’s southern star. Mass executions sweep the realm. Yiwei: Venus crossed Shao Wei. Bingwu: Venus stood in Shao Wei yet blazed by day. September, jiayin: Venus crossed the Left Law Enforcer. Dingchou: Saturn crossed the Net. Frontier armies mobilize. That March Shixing governor Xu Daofu rose in revolt. April: Lu Xun scourged Hunan, seized Baling, and drove on the capital approaches. That month Left Director Meng Chang, despairing of the throne’s strength, took poison. Seventh year’s twelfth month: Liu Fan sent up Xu Daofu’s head while Du Huidu slew Lu Xun; both trophies reached Jiankang. Eighth year, June: Liu Daogui died while serving as Yu inspector. August: Empress Wang passed away. September: Yan inspector Liu Fan and left director Xie Hun were put to death. Liu Yu’s western column finished Liu Yi and paraded his head. December: Zhu Lingshi was sent to conquer Shu. Seventh year, fourth month, xinchou: Mars entered the Ghost asterism. Qin lands see war. Another gloss targets Yongzhou. June: Venus shone by day in the Wings. Jihai: Saturn crossed the Celestial Pass. Ministerial treason is portended. August: Venus crossed the Chamber’s second south star. November, bingzi: Venus crossed the Weeping star. That July Zhu Lingshi conquered Shu. Shu rose once more and was suppressed. Eighth year, July, guihai: the Moon occulted the Chamber’s second north star. Jiwei: the Moon crossed the Eastern Well’s axe stars. August, wushen: the Moon crossed the Sobbing star. October, xinhai: the Moon occulted the Celestial Pass. War follows. November, dingchou: Saturn crossed the Eastern Well. High lords face mourning. December, guimao: Saturn crossed the Well’s axe stars. That August Empress Wang died. September: Liu Fan and Xie Hun were killed while Liu Yi’s faction was crushed. December: Zhu Lingshi finished the Shu pacification. Ninth year, February: Mars entered the Ghost asterism. War and funerals coincide. Venus crossed the South River stars. War stirs. May, renchen: Venus crossed the Right Law Enforcer and shone by day. July, gengwu: the Moon occulted the Hook-and-Hasp. Court spokesmen face ruin. September, gengwu: Jupiter crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star. Jichou: the Moon crossed the left Horn. Liu Yu held unchecked power while wars rolled on. Year ten: Liu Yu struck Sima Xiuzhi. Imperial forces lost; Xiuzhi’s party bolted to Chang’an. Tenth year, first month, dingmao: the Moon crossed the Net. High command faces punishment matching the stellar seat. February, jiyou: the Moon crossed the Chamber’s north star. May, renyin: the Moon crossed the Oxherd’s southern star. Yichou: Jupiter crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star. Glosses matched earlier Coachman omens. June, bingshen: the Moon occulted the Root. A commander dies while the court orders killings. July, gengchen: the Moon crossed the Celestial Pass. War is portended. Mars crossed the Well’s axe stars. Saturn crossed the Ghost asterism and stationed there. Mourning among magnates and dynastic upheaval. August, dingyou: the Moon occulted the Oxherd’s southern star. Same gloss as the prior Oxherd omen. September: Saturn crossed the Ghost asterism. The sovereign faces dread. Dingsi: Venus entered the Feathered Forest. December, jiyou: the Moon crossed western Sincerity. Hidden intrigue spreads. Year eleven: Linyi struck Jiaozhou and was beaten back. Eleventh year, March, dingsi: the Moon entered the Net. Realm-wide war follows. A variant stresses frontier hosts. Jimao: Mars entered the Ghost asterism. Leap month, bingwu: Saturn re-entered the Ghost asterism. Drought, plague, and treasonous officials follow. May, guimao: Mars entered the Supreme Palace. Jiachen: Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer. June, jiwei: Venus crossed the Eastern Well. Qin-zone warfare again. Wuyin: Venus crossed the Ghost asterism. National mourning. July, xinchou: the Moon crossed the Net. Same Net gloss as before. August, renzi: the Moon crossed the Root. Same Root gloss as before. Gengshen: Venus moved direct into the enclosure through the right rear gate. Dingmao: Venus occulted the Left Law Enforcer. November, guihai: the Moon entered the Net. Same Net entry gloss. Yiwei: the Moon entered the Ghost asterism with a lunar halo. Twelfth year, May, jiashen: Jupiter stationed between House and Heart, Song’s celestial field. Liu Yu received his first investiture as Duke of Song. June, renzi: Venus moved direct into the enclosure’s right rear gate. Jisi: the Moon crossed the Net. Same Net gloss as before. July: the Moon crossed the Ox lodge. October, bingxu: the Moon entered the Net. Thirteenth year, May, bingzi: the Moon crossed Xuanyuan. Dinghai: the Moon crossed the Oxherd. Guisi: Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer. August, jiyou: the Moon crossed the Oxherd. Dingmao: the Moon crossed the Supreme Palace. The sovereign faces ill portent. September, renchen: Mars crossed Xuanyuan. October, wushen: the Moon crossed the Net. Glosses matched prior entries. The Moon crossed the Winnowing Basket (Ji). National mourning follows. Jiayin: the Moon crossed the Net. Same Net omen again. Yimao: Saturn crossed the enclosure and lingered over seventy days. A lost-ruler omen is recorded. Renxu: the Moon crossed the Supreme Palace. Fourteenth year, March, guisi: Venus crossed the Five Feudal Lords. May, gengzi: the Moon crossed the Supreme Palace. July, jiachen: Mars crossed the Ghost asterism. Qin lands face war, drought, and battlefield death. Magnates mourn, dynastic temples shift, and traitorous ministers appear. Liu Yu held absolute power, campaigns and dearth came in waves, and he ultimately transferred the Jin mandate. Dingsi: the Moon crossed the Eastern Well. A field commander will perish. August, jiazi: Venus crossed Xuanyuan. Guiyou: Saturn entered the enclosure, crossed the Right Law Enforcer, and lingered inside over two hundred days. Saturn’s long stay in the enclosure marks a dying dynasty and shifting kingship. September, yiwei: Venus entered the enclosure and crossed the Left Law Enforcer. Dingsi: the Moon entered the Supreme Palace. High lords face mourning. October, jiashen: the Moon entered the Supreme Palace. Guisi: Mars entered the enclosure, struck the western commander star, advanced to the left rear gate, stopped twenty days, then turned retrograde. Yixi twelve, July: Liu Yu attacked Later Qin’s Yao Hong. Thirteenth year, August: Yao Hong was taken and Si, Yan, Qin, and Yong were subdued. Fourteenth year: Liu Yu came back to Pengcheng and took the Song dukedom. November: Liu Muzhi, left director and ex-general, died. Next year western foes struck Chang’an, Zhu Lingshi’s Yongzhou army was swallowed, and court forces abandoned the city for the east. December: the emperor died.
37
恭帝元熙元年正月丙午，三月壬寅，五月丙申，月皆犯太微，占悉同上。 乙卯，辰星犯軒轅。 六月庚辰，太白犯太微。 七月己卯，月犯太微，太白晝見。 自義熙元年至是，太白經天者九，日蝕者四，皆從上始，革代更王，臣失君之象也。 是夜，太白犯哭星。 十二月丁巳，月、太白俱入羽林。 二年二月庚午，填星犯太微。 占悉同上。 元年七月，劉裕受宋王。 是年六月，帝遜位於宋。
Yuanxi one: the Moon crossed the Supreme Palace on bingwu, renyin, and bingshen with the usual enclosure glosses. Yimao: Mercury crossed Xuanyuan. June, gengchen: Venus crossed the Supreme Palace. July, jimao: the Moon crossed the enclosure while Venus shone by day. From Yixi one onward Venus transited the full heavens nine times and four eclipses began at the top—omens of usurpation, fallen kings, and ministers overpowering their sovereign. That very night Venus crossed the Weeping star. December, dingsi: Moon and Venus entered the Feathered Forest together. Year two, February, gengwu: Saturn crossed the Supreme Palace. Same enclosure glosses repeated. First year, July: Liu Yu took the Song princedom. That June the emperor yielded the throne to Song.
38
妖星客星
Anomalous broom stars and guest stars
39
魏文帝黃初三年九月甲辰，客星見太微左掖門內。 占曰：「客星出太微，國有兵喪。 」十月，帝南征孫權。 是後，累有征役。 六年十月乙未，有星孛於少微，歷軒轅，占：「為兵喪，除舊布新之象。 」時帝軍廣陵，辛丑，親御甲胃觀兵。 明年五月，帝崩。
Wei Huangchu three, ninth month, jiachen: a guest star shone inside the enclosure’s left rear gate. A guest star leaving the enclosure foretells war and state funerals. October: the emperor marched south against Sun Quan. Endless conscription followed. Year six, October, yiwei: a broom star blazed through Shao Wei and Xuanyuan; gloss—war, mourning, and regime renewal. The host lay at Guangling; on xinchou the sovereign inspected the troops in mail. Next year’s May: the emperor died.
40
明帝太和六年十一月丙寅，有星孛於翼，近太微上將星。 占曰：「為兵喪。 」甘氏曰：「孛彗所當之國，是受其殃。 翼又楚分野，孫權封略也。 」明年，權有遼東之敗。 又明年，諸葛亮入秦川。 孫權發兵，緣江淮屯要衝，權自圍新城以應亮，天子東征權。
Wei Mingdi Taihe six, November, bingyin: a broom star appeared in the Wings beside the enclosure’s commander star. War and funerals are portended. Gan Shi warns that comets punish the realm they touch. The Wings mark Chu, Sun Quan’s domain. The following year Sun Quan met disaster in Liaodong. The next year Zhuge Liang advanced into the Qin valleys. Sun Quan mobilized along the Yangzi and Huai, personally besieged Xincheng to aid Zhuge Liang, while the Wei emperor marched east against him.
41
青龍四年十月甲申，有星孛於大辰，長三尺。 乙酉，又孛於東方。 十一月己亥，彗星見，犯宦者天紀星。 占曰：「大辰為天王，天下有喪。 」劉向《五紀論》曰：「《春秋》，星孛於東方，不言宿者，不加宿也。 宦者在天市，為中外有兵。 天紀為地震，孛彗主兵喪。 」景初元年六月，地震。 九月，吳將朱然圍江夏。 皇后毛氏崩。 二年正月，討公孫文懿。 三年正月，明帝崩。
Qinglong four, October, jiashen: a three-foot broom star appeared at the Great Chen. Yiyou: another eastern broom star. November, jihai: a comet crossed the eunuch and Celestial Tally stars. The Great Chen is the royal seat; the realm faces mourning. Liu Xiang’s Five Eras treatise notes that unnamed eastern comets omit explicit lodge tags. Eunuch stars sit in the Celestial Market, signaling war inside and out. The Celestial Tally star signals earthquakes; comets and brooms still mean war and mourning. Jingchu one, June: an earthquake struck. September: Wu’s Zhu Ran ringed Jiangxia. Empress Mao passed away. Year two, first month: expedition against Gongsun Wenyi. Third year, first month: Emperor Ming died.
42
景初二年八月，彗星見張，長三尺，逆西行，四十一日滅。 占同上。 張，周分野。 十月癸巳，客星見危，逆行，在離宮北、騰蛇南。 甲辰，犯宗星。 己酉，滅。 占曰：「客星所出有兵喪。 虛危為宗廟，又為墳墓。 客星近離宮，則宮中將有大喪，就先君於宗廟之象也。 三年正月，帝崩。
Jingchu two, August: a three-foot comet in Zhang moved west retrograde and vanished after forty-one days. Same comet gloss as prior entries. Zhang marks the Zhou celestial field. October, guisi: a guest star shone in Rooftops, retrograde between the Detached Palace and Coiled Serpent. Jiachen: it crossed the Ancestral star. Jiyou: it vanished. Guest stars bring war and death to their station. Void and Rooftops mark the dynastic shrine and burial ground. Near the Detached Palace it foretells deep palace mourning, as though the ruler were joining his ancestors. Third year, first month: the emperor died.
43
少帝正始元年十月乙酉，彗星見西方，在尾，長三丈，拂牽牛，犯太白。 十一月甲子，進犯羽林。 占曰：「尾為燕，又為吳，牛亦吳越之分。 太白為上將，羽林中軍兵。 為吳越有喪，中軍兵動。 」二年五月，吳遣三將寇邊。 吳太子登卒。 六月，宣帝討諸葛恪於皖。 太尉滿寵薨。 六年八月戊午，彗星見七星，長二尺，色白，進至張，積二十三日滅。 七年十一月癸亥，又見軫，長一尺，積百五十六日滅。 九年三月，又見昴，長六尺，色青白，芒西南指。 七月，又見翼，長二尺，進至軫，積四十二日滅。 案占曰：「七星張為周分野，翼軫為楚，昴為趙魏。 彗所以除舊布新，主兵喪也。 」嘉平元年，宣帝誅曹爽兄弟及其党與，皆夷三族，京師嚴兵。 三年，誅楚王彪，又襲王淩於淮南。 淮南，東楚也。 魏諸王幽於鄴。
Zhengshi one, October, yiyou: a western comet in the Tail, three rods long, swept the Oxherd and crossed Venus. November, jiazi: the comet advanced into the Feathered Forest. The Tail marks Yan and Wu; the Ox marks Wu-Yue. Venus is the commander star; the Feathered Forest is palace guards. Wu-Yue face funerals while household regiments stir. Year two, May: Wu sent three generals to strike the frontier. Wu crown prince Sun Deng died. June: Sima Yi attacked Zhuge Ke at Wan. Grand Commandant Man Chong passed away. Year six, August, wuwu: a white two-foot comet moved from the Seven Stars to Zhang and vanished in twenty-three days. Year seven, November, guihai: another comet in the Chariot lasted one hundred fifty-six days. Year nine, March: a six-foot bluish-white comet in the Pleiades aimed its tail southwest. July: a two-foot comet in the Wings crept to the Chariot and died out in forty-two days. Commentary maps the Seven Stars and Zhang to Zhou, Wings and Chariot to Chu, and the Pleiades to Zhao-Wei. Comets scour away the old order and foretell war and death. Jiaping one: Sima Yi slew Cao Shuang’s faction to the third degree and locked down Luoyang. Year three: Prince Biao of Chu died and Wang Ling was crushed in Huainan. Huainan counts as eastern Chu territory. Wei imperial princes were imprisoned at Ye.
44
嘉平三年十一月癸亥，有星孛于營室，西行，積九十日滅。 占曰：「有兵喪。 室為後宮，後宮且有亂。 」四年二月丁酉，彗星見西方，在胃，長五六丈，色白，芒南指，貫參，積二十日滅。 五年十一月，彗星又見軫，長五丈，在太微左執法西，東南指，積百九十日滅。 案占：「胃，兗州之分野。 參，主兵。 太微，天子庭。 執法，為執政。 孛彗為兵喪，除舊布新之象。 」正元元年二月，李豐、豐弟翼、後父張緝等謀亂，皆誅，皇后亦廢。 九月，帝廢為齊王。
Jiaping three, November, guihai: a ninety-day western broom star in Encampment. War and funerals follow. Encampment marks the harem, which now faces turmoil. Year four, February, dingyou: a huge white western comet in the Stomach pierced Orion and faded in twenty days. Year five, November: a five-rod comet in the Chariot west of the Left Law Enforcer lingered one hundred ninety days. Commentary ties the Stomach to Yanzhou. Orion’s Belt stars govern warfare. The enclosure is the celestial court of the sovereign. Law Enforcer stars mark chief ministers. Comets signal war, death, and dynastic turnover. Zhengyuan one, February: Li Feng, Li Yi, Zhang Ji, and co. fell to execution and the empress was cast down. September: the emperor was demoted to Prince of Qi.
45
高貴鄉公正元元年十一月，白氣出南斗側，廣數丈，長竟天。 王肅曰：「蚩尤之旗也，東南其有亂乎！ 」二年正月，有彗星見於吳楚分，西北竟天。 鎮東大將軍毋丘儉等據淮南叛，景帝討平之。 案占：「蚩尤旗見，王者征伐四方。 」自後又征淮南，西平巴蜀。 是歲，吳主孫亮五鳳元年也。 斗牛，吳越分。 案占：「吳有兵喪，除舊布新之象也。 」太平三年，孫綝盛兵圍宮，廢亮為會稽王，故《國志》又書于吳也。 淮南江東同揚州地，故于時變見吳、楚。 楚之分則魏之淮南，多與吳同災。 是以毋丘儉以孛為己應，遂起兵而敗。 後三年，即魏甘露二年，諸葛誕又反淮南，吳遣將救之。 及城陷，誕眾與吳兵死沒各數萬人，猶前長星之應也。
Gaoxiang Duke Zhengyuan one, November: white qi flared beside the Dipper, yards wide and sky-long. Wang Su calls it Chiyou’s war-banner and asks if the southeast will riot. Year two, first month: a comet filled the Wu-Chu sector northwestward. Wuqiu Jian seized Huainan until Sima Shi crushed the revolt. The Chiyou-banner gloss means the sovereign sends armies everywhere. Later campaigns hit Huainan again and subdued Ba-Shu. The same year was Sun Liang of Wu’s Wufeng era. The Dipper-Ox zone marks Wu-Yue. Commentary says Wu faces war and renewal. Taiping three: Sun Chen besieged the palace, demoted Sun Liang to Prince of Kuaiji, so the chronicle logs it for Wu too. Huainan and Jiangdong both lie in Yangzhou, so the sign showed in Wu-Chu. Wei’s Huainan sector mirrors Wu’s omens. Wuqiu Jian read the comet as his own sign, rose anyway, and lost. Three years on, Ganlu two: Zhuge Dan rebelled in Huainan with Wu relief columns. At the fall tens of thousands of Dan’s and Wu’s soldiers perished—fulfilling the long-comet omen.
46
甘露二年十一月，彗星見角，色白。 占曰：「彗星見兩角間色白者，軍起不戰，邦有大喪。 」景元元年，高貴鄉公為成濟所害。 四年十月丁丑，客星見太微中，轉東南行，歷軫宿，積七日滅。 占曰：「客星出太微，有兵喪。 」景元元年，高貴鄉公被害。
Ganlu two, November: a white comet in the Horn. A white comet between the Horns means armies mass without fighting and the dynasty mourns deeply. Jingyuan one: Cao Mao fell to Cheng Ji’s blade. Year four, October, dingchou: a week-long guest star drifted through the enclosure toward the Chariot. Guest stars leaving the enclosure mean war and death. Jingyuan one repeated Cao Mao’s assassination.
47
元帝景元三年十一月壬寅，彗星見亢，色白，長五寸，轉北行，積四十五日滅。 占曰：「為兵喪。 」一曰：「彗星見亢，天子失德。 」四年，鍾會、鄧艾伐蜀，克之。 二將反亂，皆誅。
Wei Emperor Yuan, Jingyuan three, November, renyin: a five-inch white comet in the Neck moved north forty-five days. War and funerals again. A variant warns the ruler loses moral mandate. Year four: Zhong Hui and Deng Ai took Shu. Both generals mutinied and died under sentence.
48
咸熙二年五月，彗星見王良，長丈餘，色白，東南指，積十二日滅。 占曰：「王良，天子御駟。 彗星掃之，禪代之表，除舊布新之象也。 白色為喪。 王良在東壁宿，又并州之分野。 」八月，文帝崩。 十二月，武帝受魏禪。
Xianxi two, May: a white, yard-long comet at Wang Liang pointed southeast twelve days. Wang Liang marks the royal charioteer stars. A comet brushing Wang Liang foretells abdication and regime change. White comets add mourning. Wang Liang sits in Wall and ties to Bingzhou’s celestial field. August: King Wen (Sima Zhao) died, clearing the way for usurpation. December: Sima Yan accepted Wei’s abdication.
49
武帝泰始四年正月丙戌，彗星見軫，青白色，西北行，又轉東行。 占曰：「為兵喪，軫又楚分野。 」三月，皇太后王氏崩。 十月，吳寇江夏、襄陽。 五年九月，星孛于紫宮。 占如上。 紫宮，天子內宮。 十年，武元楊皇后崩。 十年十二月，有星孛於軫。 占曰：「天下兵起，軫又楚分野。」
Jin Taishi four, first month, bingxu: a green-white comet in the Chariot drifted northwest then east. War and death, with Chu’s field implicated. March: Empress Dowager Wang passed away. October: Wu struck Jiangxia and Xiangyang. Year five, September: a broom star swept the Purple Palace. The usual Purple Palace gloss applied. The Purple Palace is the celestial inner court. Year ten: Empress Yang Wu yuan died. Year ten, December: a broom star in the Chariot. Realm-wide war looms; the Chariot again marks Chu.
50
咸寧二年六月甲戌，星孛於氐。 占曰：「天子失德易政。 氐，又兗州分。 」七月，星孛大角。 大角為帝坐。 八月，星孛太微，至翼、北斗、三台。 占曰：「太微，天子庭，大人惡之。 」一曰：「有改王。 翼，又楚分野。 北斗主殺罰，三台為三公。 」三年正月，星孛於西方。 三月，星孛於胃。 胃，徐州分。 四月，星孛女御。 女御為後宮。 五月，又孛於東方。 七月，星孛紫宮。 上曰：「天下易主。 」四年四月，蚩尤旗見東井。 後二年，傾三方伐吳，是其應也。 五年三月，星孛于柳。 四月，又孛於女御。 七月，孛于紫宮。 占曰：「外臣陵主。 柳，又三河分野。 大角、太微、紫宮、女御並為王者。 」明年吳亡，是其應也。 孛主兵喪。 征吳之役，三河、徐、兗之兵悉出，交戰于吳楚之地，吳丞相都督以下梟戮十數，偏裨行陣之徒馘斬萬計，皆其徵也。
Xianning two, June, jiaxu: a broom star in the Root. The throne loses virtue and shifts policy. The Root also maps to Yanzhou. July: a broom star swept Arcturus. Arcturus is the celestial throne. August: a broom ran through the enclosure to Wings, the Dipper, and Three Steps. The enclosure warns great lords of ill omen. A variant predicts a new king. Wings again mark Chu. The Dipper rules executions; the Three Steps are the three dukes. Year three, first month: a western broom star. March: a broom in the Stomach. The Stomach maps to Xuzhou. April: a broom crossed the Woman Attendant stars. Those stars mark the harem. May: another eastern broom. July: a broom swept the Purple Palace. High commentary reads: the throne changes hands. Year four, April: Chiyou’s banner showed in the Eastern Well. Two years later the tripartite assault on Wu matched the sign. Year five, March: a broom in the Willow. April: another sweep of the Woman Attendant. July: the Purple Palace was broomed again. Border ministers bully the throne. The Willow marks the Three Rivers zone. Arcturus, the enclosure, Purple Palace, and Woman Attendant all image the sovereign. Next year Wu fell—exactly as foretold. Broom stars mean war and death. The conquest of Wu threw Three Rivers, Xu, and Yan armies into Wu-Chu fighting, beheading Wu’s command stack by the dozen and common soldiers by the myriad—each tally matched the omens.
51
太康二年八月，有星孛于張。 占曰：「為兵喪。 」十一月，星孛於斬轅。 占曰：「後宮當之。 」四年三月戊申，星孛於西南。 是年，齊王攸、任城王陵、琅邪王伷、新都王該薨。 八年九月，星孛於南斗，長數十丈餘日滅。 占曰：「斗主爵祿，國有大憂。 」一曰：「孛于斗，王者疾病，天下易政，大亂兵起。」
Taikang two, August: a broom star in Zhang. War and mourning follow. In November a comet swept across the Coachman’s yoke stars in the eastern sky. The harem bears the omen. Year four, March, wushen: a broom star in the southwest. That year Princes You, Ling, Xiu, and Gai died. Year eight, September: a vast broom star on the Dipper lasted many days. The Dipper ties to offices and stipends; the realm faces deep sorrow. A variant adds royal illness, political overturn, and massive war.
52
太熙元年四月，客星在紫宮。 占曰：「為兵喪。 」太康未，武帝耽宴遊，多疾病。 是月己酉，帝崩。 永平元年，賈后誅楊駿及其黨與，皆夷三族，楊太后亦見弑。 又誅汝南王亮、太保衛瓘、楚王瑋，王室兵喪之應也。
Taixi one, April: a guest star shone in the Purple Palace. War and death follow. Late Taikang saw Emperor Wu lost in revels and sickness. That month, jiyou: the emperor died. Yongping one: Empress Jia wiped out Yang Jun’s faction to the third degree and killed Empress Dowager Yang. She also killed Princes Liang and Wei and Grand Guardian Wei Guan—royal bloodletting matching the omens.
53
惠帝元康五年四月，有星孛於奎，至軒轅、太微，經三台、太陵。 占曰：「奎為魯，又為庫兵，軒轅為後宮，太微天子庭，三台為三司，太陵有積尸死喪之事。 」其後武庫火，西羌反。 後五年，司空張華遇禍，賈后廢死，魯公賈謐誅。 又明年，趙王倫篡位。 於是三王興兵討倫，兵士戰死十餘萬人。
Yuankang five, April: a broom star ran from Kui through Xuanyuan and the enclosure across Three Steps and Great Tomb. Kui marks Lu and arsenals; Xuanyuan the harem; the enclosure the court; Three Steps the ministers; Great Tomb mass death. Then the arsenal caught fire and western Qiang rose. Five years on: Zhang Hua perished, Empress Jia fell, and Jia Mi died. Next year Prince Zhao Lun seized the throne. Three princes marched on Lun and left a hundred thousand dead.
54
永康元年三月，妖星見南方。 占曰：「妖星出，天下大兵將起。 」是月賈后殺太子，趙王倫尋廢殺后，斬司空張華，又廢帝自立。 於是三王並起，迭總天權。 其十二月，彗星出牽牛之西，指天市。 占曰：「牛者七政始，彗出之，改元易號之象也。 天市一名天府，一名天子旗，帝坐在其中。 」明年，趙王倫篡位，改元，尋為大兵所滅。 二年四月，彗星見齊分。 占曰：「齊有兵喪。 」是時，齊王冏起兵討趙王倫。 倫滅，冏擁兵不朝，專權淫奢。 明年，誅死。
Yongkang one, March: a freak southern star. Uncanny stars herald realm-wide war. That month Empress Jia murdered the crown prince; Lun then killed her and Zhang Hua, deposed the emperor, and seized power. Three princes rose in rotation, each holding the reins. That December a comet sprang west of the Oxherd toward the Celestial Market. The Ox opens the seven celestial powers; a comet there means new era names. The Market is heaven’s treasury, the royal banner, with the throne inside. Next year Lun seized power, changed the era, then fell to a great host. Year two, April: a comet in Qi’s sector. Qi faces war and death. Prince Jiong of Qi marched against Zhao Lun. After Lun fell, Jiong kept armies private, skipped court, and ruled licentiously. The following year Jiong was executed.
55
太安元年四月，彗星晝見。 二年三月，彗星見東方，指三台。 占曰：「兵喪之象。 三台為三公。 」三年正月，東海王越執太尉、長沙王乂，張方又殺之。
Tai’an one, April: a daylight comet. Year two, March: an eastern comet aimed at the Three Steps. War and mourning are imaged. Three Steps mark the three dukes. Year three, first month: Sima Yue arrested Sima Yi; Zhang Fang then killed him.
56
永興元年五月，客星守畢。 占曰：「天子絕嗣。 」一曰：「大臣有誅。 」時諸王擁兵，其後惠帝失統，終無繼嗣。 二年八月，有星孛于昴畢。 占曰：「為兵喪。 昴畢又趙魏分野。 」十月丁丑，有星孛於北斗。 占曰：「琁璣更授，天子出走。 」又曰：「強國發兵，諸侯爭權。 」是後，諸王交兵，皆有應。 明年，惠帝崩。
Yongxing one, May: a guest star stationed at the Net. The imperial line risks extinction. A variant cites ministerial executions. Princely armies ruled; Hui never secured an heir. Year two, August: a broom through Pleiades and Net. War and death again. Pleiades-Net map to Zhao-Wei. October, dingchou: a broom on the Dipper. The Dipper’s mandate shifts; the emperor runs. Another line warns of hegemons and baronial strife. Princes then tore at one another, each omen fulfilled. Next year Emperor Hui died.
57
成帝咸和四年七月，有星孛於西北，犯斗，二十三日滅。 占曰：「為兵亂。 」十二月，郭默殺江州刺史劉胤，荊州刺史陶侃討默，斬之。 時石勒又始僭號。
Xianhe four, July: a northwestern broom crossed the Dipper and died in twenty-three days. Mutiny is portended. December: Guo Mo slew Liu Yin; Tao Kan took his head. Shi Le too began usurping royal styles.
58
咸康二年正月辛巳，彗星夕見西方，在奎。 占曰：「為兵喪。 奎，又為邊兵。 」三年正月，石季龍僭天王位。 四年，石季龍伐慕容皝，不克。 既退，皝追擊之，又破麻秋。 時皝稱蕃，邊兵之應也。 六年二月庚辰，有星孛於太微。 七年三月，杜皇后崩。
Xiankang two, first month, xinsi: an evening comet in the Strider. War and mourning. Kui also signals frontier armies. Third year, first month: Shi Hu took the Celestial King title. Year four: Shi Hu attacked Murong Huang without success. On retreat Murong Huang chased him and broke Ma Qiu too. Murong Huang’s submission matched the border-troop omen. Year six, February, gengchen: a broom in the Supreme Palace. Year seven, March: Empress Du died.
59
康帝建元元年十一月六日，彗星見亢，長七尺，白色。 占曰：「亢為朝廷，主兵喪。 」二年，康帝崩。
Jianyuan one, eleventh month, sixth day: a seven-foot white comet in the Neck. The Neck marks the court and its wars and funerals. Year two: Emperor Kang died.
60
穆帝永和五年十一月乙卯，彗星見於亢。 芒西向，色白，長一丈。 六年正月丁丑，彗星又見於亢。 占曰：「為兵喪、疾疫。 」其五年八月，褚裒北征，兵敗。 十一月，冉閔殺石遵，又盡殺胡十餘萬人，於是中土大亂。 十二月，褚裒薨。 是年，大疫。
Yonghe five, November, yimao: a comet in the Neck. Its tail aimed west, white, one rod long. Year six, first month, dingchou: another Neck comet. War, mourning, and plague. That year’s August: Chu Pou’s northern campaign failed. November: Ran Min slew Shi Zun and massacred a hundred thousand Hu, throwing the heartland into chaos. December: Chu Pou died. That year brought a great epidemic.
61
升平二年五月丁亥，彗星出天船，在胃。 占曰：「為兵喪，除舊布新。 出天船，外夷侵。 」一曰：「為大水。 」四年五月，天下大水。 五年，穆帝崩。
Shengping two, May, dinghai: a comet from Celestial Boat in the Stomach. War, death, and renewal. From Celestial Boat marks foreign invasion. A variant cites catastrophic flood. Year four, May: realm-wide flooding. Year five: Emperor Mu died.
62
哀帝興甯元年八月，有星孛於角亢，入天市。 案占曰：「為兵喪。 」三年正月，皇后王氏崩。 二月，帝崩。 三月，慕容恪攻沒洛陽，沈勁等戰死。
Xingning one, August: a broom from Horn and Neck into the Celestial Market. Commentary: war and mourning. Third year, first month: Empress Wang died. February: the emperor died. March: Murong Ke took Luoyang; Shen Jin fell fighting.
63
海西太和四年二月，客星見紫宮西垣，至七月乃滅。 占曰：「客星守紫宮，臣弑主。 」六年，桓溫廢帝為海西公。
Haixi Taihe four, February–July: a guest star on the Purple Palace west wall. A guest star on the Purple Palace marks regicide. Year six: Huan Wen demoted the sovereign to Duke of Haixi.
64
孝武甯康二年正月丁巳，有星孛於女虛，經氐、亢、角、軫、翼、張。 至三月丙戌，彗星，見於氐。 九月丁丑，有星孛於天市。 占曰：「為兵喪。 」太元元年七月，苻堅破涼州，虜張天錫。
Ningkang two, first month, dingsi: a broom from Girl-Void across Root, Horn, Chariot, Wings, and Zhang. Third month, bingxu: a comet showed in the Root. September, dingchou: a broom in the Celestial Market. War and mourning. Taiyuan one, July: Fu Jian conquered Liangzhou and took Zhang Tianxi.
65
太元十一年三月，客星在南斗，至六月乃沒。 占曰：「有兵，有赦。 」是後司、雍、兗、冀常有兵役。 十二年正月大赦，八月又大赦。 十五年七月壬申，有星孛於北河戍，經太微、三台、文昌，入北斗，色白，長十餘丈。 八月戊戌，入紫宮乃減。 占曰：「北河戍一名胡門，胡有兵喪。 掃太微，入紫微，王者當之。 三台為三公，文昌為將相，將相三公有災。 入北斗，諸侯戮。 」一曰：「掃北斗，強國發兵，諸侯爭權，大人憂。 」二十一年，帝崩。 隆安元年，王恭、殷仲堪、桓玄等並發兵，表以誅王國寶為名。 朝廷順而殺之，並斬其從弟緒，司馬道子由是失勢，禍亂成矣。 十八年二月，客星在尾中，至九月乃滅。 占曰：「燕有兵喪。 」二十年，慕容垂息寶伐魏，為所破，死者數萬人。 二十一年，垂死，國遂衰亡。 二十年九月，有蓬星如粉絮，東南行，歷女虛，至哭星。 占曰：「蓬星見，不出三年，必有亂臣戮死於市。 」是時，王國寶交構朝廷。 二十一年九月，帝崩。 隆安元年，王恭等興兵，而朝廷殺王國寶、王緒。
Taiyuan eleven, March–June: a guest star lingered in the Dipper. War and pardon both follow. Si, Yong, Yan, and Ji then saw endless levies. Year twelve: great pardons in first and eighth months. Year fifteen, July, renshen: a colossal white broom ran from the Northern River Guard through the enclosure, Three Steps, and Civilized Glory into the Dipper. August, wuxu: it entered the Purple Palace and vanished. The Northern River Guard is the Hu Gate—steppe war and death. Brushing the enclosure and Purple Tenuity hits the sovereign. Three Steps are dukes; Civilized Glory is generals—both tiers suffer. Entering the Dipper marks executed lords. A variant adds hegemonic armies, baronial rivalry, and high lords’ mourning. Year twenty-one: the emperor died. Long’an one: Wang Gong, Yin Zhongkan, Huan Xuan, and allies mobilized to kill Wang Guobao. The court complied, executed Guobao and Wang Xu, leaving Sima Daozi broken as chaos set in. Year eighteen, February–September: a guest star lingered in the Tail. Yan lands face war and death. Year twenty: Murong Bao attacked Wei and lost tens of thousands. Year twenty-one: Murong Chui died and Former Yan withered. Year twenty, September: a misty broom drifted southeast through Girl-Void to the Weeping star. Fuzzy stars within three years bring a traitor’s public execution. Wang Guobao was then poisoning court politics. Year twenty-one, September: the emperor died. Long’an one: Wang Gong’s revolt prompted the court to kill Guobao and Xu.
66
安帝隆安四年二月己丑，有星孛於奎，長三丈，上至閣道、紫宮西蕃，入北斗魁，至三台，三月，遂經於太微帝坐端門。 占曰：「彗星掃天子庭閣道，易主之象。 」經三台入北斗。 占同上條。 十二月戊寅，有星孛于貫索、天市、天津。 占曰：「貴臣獄死，內外有兵喪。 天津為賊斷，王道天下不通。 」案占：「災在吳越。 」五年二月，有孫恩兵亂，攻侵郡國。 於是內外戒嚴，營陣屯守，柵斷淮口。 九月，桓玄表至，逆旨陵上。 其後玄遂篡位，亂京都，大饑，人相食，百姓流亡，皆其應也。
Long’an four, jichou: a three-rod broom in Kui climbed to the Forbidden Passage, crossed the Purple Palace west wall and Dipper ladle, reached Three Steps, then in March swept the enclosure throne and Portal Gate. A comet brushing the court passage means a new sovereign. It crossed Three Steps into the Dipper. Same gloss as the prior Three Steps–Dipper line. December, wuyin: a broom through Coiled Rope, Market, and Ford. High officials perish in jail while war spreads inside and out. When the Ford is severed, the king’s highway is choked. Commentary pins the sign on Wu-Yue. Year five, February: Sun En’s mutiny ravaged the districts. The realm locked down, armies walled the Huai crossings. September: Huan Xuan’s arrogant memorial snubbed the throne. Huan Xuan seized power, starved Jiankang into cannibalism, and drove the people—all matching the omens.
67
元興元年十月，有客星色白如粉絮，在太微西，至十二月入太微。 占曰：「兵入天子庭。 」二年十二月，桓玄篡位，放遷帝、后於尋陽，以永安何皇后為零陵君。 三年二月，劉裕盡誅桓氏。
Yuanxing one, October–December: a floss-white guest star slid from west of the enclosure into it. War enters the celestial court. Yuanxing two, December: Huan Xuan seized the throne and exiled the sovereigns. Yuanxing three, February: Liu Yu wiped out the Huans.
68
義熙十一年五月甲申，彗星二出天市，掃帝坐，在房心北。 房心，宋之分野。 案占：「得彗柄者興，除舊布新，宋興之象。 」十四年五月庚子，有星孛於北斗魁中。 七月癸亥，彗星出太微西，柄起上相星下，芒漸長至十餘丈，進掃北斗、紫微、中台。 占曰：「彗出太微，社稷亡，天下易王； 入北斗、紫微，帝宮空。 」十四年，劉裕還彭城，受宋公。 十二月，帝崩。
Yixi eleven, May, jiashen: twin comets from the Market brushed the throne north of the Heart. Heart-Chamber marks Song’s celestial territory. Whoever catches the comet’s handle rises—an omen of Song’s founding. Yixi fourteen, May, gengzi: a broom inside the Dipper’s ladle. July, guihai: a comet sprang west of the enclosure, handle under the senior minister, tail growing ten rods to brush Dipper, Purple Tenuity, and central Step. A comet leaving the enclosure ends the dynasty and swaps the king; piercing Dipper and Purple Tenuity empties the throne hall." Yixi fourteen: Liu Yu took the Song dukedom at Pengcheng. December: the emperor died.
69
恭帝元年正月戊戌，有星孛於太微西蕃。 占曰：「革命之徵。 」其年，宋有天下。
Emperor Gong year one, first month, wuxu: a broom on the enclosure’s west wall. Marks mandate revolution. That year Liu Song took the realm.
70
星流隕
Shooting stars and meteor falls
71
蜀後主，諸葛亮帥大眾伐魏，屯于渭南。 有長星赤而芒角，自東北西南流，投亮營，三投再還，往大還小。 占曰：「兩軍相當，有大流星來走軍上及墜軍中者，皆破敗之徵也。 」九月，亮卒於軍，焚營而退，群帥交怨，多相誅殘。
Shu’s last king: Zhuge Liang massed an army against Wei on the Wei’s south bank. A long red meteor shot southwest toward Zhuge Liang’s camp, thrice striking and twice rebounding, swelling then shrinking. Great meteors plunging into camps mean annihilation. September: Zhuge Liang died in camp; Shu burned the lines; generals turned fratricidal.
72
魏明帝，宣帝圍公孫文懿于襄平。 八月丙寅夜，有大流星長數十丈，白色有芒鬣，從首山東北流，墜襄平城東南。 占曰：「圍城而有流星來走城上及墜城中者破。 」又曰：「星墜，當其下有戰場。 」又曰：「凡星所墜，國易姓。 」九月，文懿突圍走，至星墜所被斬，屠城，坑其眾。
Wei Mingdi: Sima Yi besieged Gongsun Yuan at Xiangping. August, bingyin night: a huge white meteor streaked from Shoushan into Xiangping’s southeast. Meteors striking a besieged city mean its fall. A second gloss sets battle where the meteor lands. A third gloss ties falls to dynastic change. September: Gongsun Yuan fled to the fall site and died; Xiangping was sacked and its people massacred.
73
元帝六月，有大流星二並如斗，見西方，分流南北，光照地，隆隆有聲。 案占：「流星為貴使，星大者使大。 」是年，鍾、鄧克蜀，二星蓋二帥之象。 二帥相背，又分流南北之應。 鍾會既叛，三軍憤怒，隆隆有聲，兵將怒之徵也。
Jin Yuan emperor’s sixth month: twin dipper-sized western meteors split north and south, lighting the earth with thunder. Meteors image great emissaries; larger stars mean greater men. That year Zhong Hui and Deng Ai took Shu—the twin meteors mirrored the two generals. Their mutual betrayal matched the split tails. When Zhong Hui mutinied, the hosts raged—the meteor’s roar imaged soldierly fury.
74
武帝七月，星隕如雨，皆西流。 占曰：「星隕為百姓叛。 西流，吳人歸晉之象也。 」二年，吳夏口督孫秀率部曲二千餘人來降。
Jin Wudi’s seventh month: a westward meteor shower. Meteor showers mean popular revolt. Westward flow showed Wu yielding to Jin." Year two: Wu’s Sun Xiu brought two thousand families over.
75
八月壬子，星隕如雨。 《劉向傳》云：「下去其上之象。 」後三年，帝崩而惠帝立，天下自此亂矣。
August, renzi: another meteor rain. Liu Xiang reads it as inferiors overturning superiors. Three years on the emperor died, Hui succeeded, and chaos engulfed the realm.
76
惠帝九月甲午，枉矢東北行，竟天。 六年六月丙午夜，有枉矢自斗魁東南行。 案占曰：「以亂伐亂。 北斗主執殺，出斗魁，居中執殺者，不直之象也。 」是後，趙王殺張、裴，廢賈后，以理太子之冤，因自篡盜，以至屠滅，以亂伐亂之應也。 一曰，氐帥齊萬年反之應也。
Huidi, September, jiawu: a crooked-arrow comet stretched northeast across the sky. Year six, June, bingwu night: a crooked arrow left the Dipper southeastward. Commentary: chaos fights chaos. The Dipper rules killing; a crooked arrow from its ladle marks unjust executioners." Then Sima Lun killed Zhang and Pei, toppled Empress Jia for the crown prince, then seized power and was destroyed—chaos answering chaos. Another line ties the sign to Qi Wannian’s Di revolt.
77
十一月辛巳，有星晝隕中天北下，光變白，有聲如雷。 案占：「名曰營首。 營首所在，下有大兵，流血。 」明年，劉元海、石勒攻略并州，多所殘滅。 王浚起燕代，引鮮卑攻掠鄴中，百姓塗地。 有聲如雷，怒之象也。
November, xinsi: a daytime fireball dropped northward, flashed white, and thundered. The books call it a Camp Head meteor. Under Camp Head falls great slaughter." Next year Liu Yuan and Shi Le ravaged Bingzhou. Wang Jun mobilized Yan-Dai Xianbei to scour Ye and trample the people. Thunderous noise images wrath.
78
七月乙丑，星隕有聲。 二年十月，星又隕有聲。 占同上。 是後，遂亡中夏。
July, yichou: noisy meteors. Year two, October: more sounding meteors. Same meteor gloss. The heartland was lost soon after.
79
五月，枉矢西南流。 是時，司馬越西破河間兵，奉迎大駕，尋收繆胤、何綏等，肆無君之心，天下惡之。 及死而石勒焚其尸柩，是其應也。
May: a crooked-arrow comet ran southwest. Sima Yue crushed Hejian, escorted the emperor, then arrested Miao Yin and He Sui, flaunting disloyalty until the realm despised him. Shi Le burned Yue’s bier—matching the omen.
80
懷帝九月辛卯，有大星如日，自西南流于東北，小者如斗，相隨，天盡赤，聲如雷。 占曰：「流星為貴使，星大者使大。 」是年五月，汲桑殺東燕王騰，遂據河北。 十一月，始遣和郁為征北將軍，鎮鄴西。 田甄等大破汲桑，斬于樂陵。 於是以甄為汲郡太守，弟蘭钜鹿太守。 小星相隨者，小將別帥之象也。 司馬越忿魏郡以東平原以南皆党于桑，以賞甄等，於是侵掠赤地。 有聲如雷，忿怒之象也。 四年十月庚子，大星西北墜，有聲。 尋而帝蒙塵於平陽。
Huaidi, September, xinmao: a sun-bright bolide crossed the sky with dipper-sized followers, reddening the heavens with thunder. Large meteors image great agents of fate. That May Ji Sang slew Prince Teng and seized north Hebei. November: He Yu was sent to camp west of Ye. Tian Zhen shattered Ji Sang and took his head at Leling. Tian Zhen became Ji governor; his brother Lan Julu governor. Trailing small meteors mark subordinate columns. Yue, furious that Wei east and Pingyuan south backed Sang, rewarded Tian Zhen’s raids until the soil was scorched bare. Thunder again signals rage. Year four, October, gengzi: a huge northwest meteor boomed. Soon the emperor suffered captivity at Pingyang.
81
元帝四月壬辰，枉矢出虛、危，沒翼、軫。 占曰：「枉矢所觸，天下之所伐。 翼、軫，荊州之分野。 」，王敦殺譙王承及甘卓，而敦又梟夷，枉矢觸翼之應也。
Jin Yuan emperor, April, renchen: a crooked arrow ran Void-Rooftops to Wings-Chariot. The crooked arrow marks heaven’s target. Wings-Chariot map to Jingzhou. Wang Dun slew Sima Cheng and Gan Zhuo, then died himself—the arrow’s touch on Wings fulfilled.
82
七月甲午，有流星大如甕，長百餘丈，青赤色，從西方來，尾分為百餘岐，或散。 時王敦之亂，百姓流亡之應也。
July, jiawu: a vat-sized western meteor split into a hundred tails. It answered Wang Dun’s revolt and the people’s flight.
83
成帝元月辛末，流星大如二斗魁，色青赤，光耀地，出奎中，沒婁北。 案占：「為饑，五穀不藏。 」是月，大旱，饑。 六年二月庚午朔，有流星大如斗，光耀地，出天市，西行人太微。 占曰：「大人當之。 」八年六月，成帝崩。
Emperor Cheng’s first month, xinwei: a twin-dipper meteor blazed from Kui to north Bond. Commentary reads famine and empty granaries. That month brought drought and hunger. Year six, second month, gengwu new moon: a dipper-bright meteor left the Market and plunged west into the enclosure. A magnate bears the sign. Year eight, June: Emperor Cheng died.
84
穆帝六月辛巳，日未入，有流星大如三斗魁，從辰巳上，東南行。 晷度推之，在箕、斗之間，蓋燕分也。 案占：「為營首。 營首之下，流血滂沱。 」是時，慕容雋僭稱大燕，攻伐無已。 十年四月癸未，流星大如斗，色赤黃，出織女，沒造父，有聲如雷。 占曰：「燕齊有兵，百姓流亡。 」其年十二月，慕容雋遂據臨漳，盡有幽、并、青、冀之地。 緣河諸將奔散，河津隔絕。 慕容恪攻齊。
Mudi, June, xinsi, before sunset: a triple-dipper meteor rose from the Chen-Si quadrant southeastward. Shadow reckoning placed it between Sieve and Dipper in Yan’s field. The books again call it Camp Head. Under Camp Head comes a blood tide." Murong Jun then claimed Great Yan and raided endlessly. Year ten, April, guiwei: a dipper-sized red-yellow meteor ran Weaving Girl to Zaofu with thunder. Yan-Qi war drives commoners into exile. That December Murong Jun took Linzhang and held You, Bing, Qing, and Ji. River generals fled and crossings closed. Murong Ke struck Qi.
85
十一月，枉矢自東南流於西北，其長半天。 四年十月庚戌，天狗見西南。 占曰：「有大兵，流血。」
November: a crooked-arrow comet crossed half the sky northwestward. Year four, October, gengxu: the Celestial Dog appeared southwest. Great battles and bloodshed follow.
86
海西十月壬申，有大流星西下，有聲如雷。 明年，遣使免袁真為庶人。 桓溫在壽春，真病死，息瑾代立，求救於苻堅。 溫破苻堅軍。 六年，壽春城陷。
Haixi reign, October, renshen: a huge western fireball boomed. Next year envoys stripped Yuan Zhen of rank. Huan Wen held Shouyang; Yuan Zhen died and his son Jin sought Fu Jian’s aid. Huan Wen broke Fu Jian’s relief column. Year six: Shouyang fell.
87
孝武十月乙卯，有奔星東南經翼、軫，聲如雷。 占曰：「楚地有兵，軍破，百姓流亡。 」十二月，苻堅荊州刺史梁成、襄陽太守閻震率眾伐竟陵，桓石虔擊大破之，生擒震，斬首七千，獲生口萬人。 聲如雷，將帥怒之象也。 十三年閏月戊辰，天狗東北下，有聲。 占曰：「有大戰，流血。 」自是後，慕容垂、翟遼、姚萇、苻登、慕容永並阻兵爭強。 十四年正月，彭城妖賊又稱偽號於皇丘，劉牢之破滅之。 三月，張道破合鄉、太山，向欽之擊走之。
Xiaowudi, October, yimao: a bolide roared southeast through Wings and Chariot. Chu sees defeat, rout, and refugee columns. December: Fu Jian’s Liang Cheng and Yan Zhen struck Jingling until Huan Shiqian shattered them, taking Yan Zhen and seven thousand heads. The thunder images generals’ fury. Year thirteen, leap month, wuchen: the Celestial Dog fell northeast audibly. Major bloodshed follows. Afterward Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, and Murong Yong kept private armies. Fourteenth year, first month: Pengcheng rebels styled themselves at Huangqiu until Liu Laozhi wiped them out. March: Zhang Dao hit Hexiang and Taishan until Xiang Qinzhi repulsed him.
88
安帝三月甲寅，流星赤色，眾多西行，經牽牛、虛、危、天津、閣道，貫太微、紫宮。 占曰：「星庶人類，眾多西行，眾將西流之象。 經天子庭，主弱臣強，諸侯兵不制。 」其年五月，孫恩侵吳郡，殺內史。 六月，至京口。 於是內外戒嚴，營陣屯守，劉裕追破之。 元興元年七月，大饑，人相食。 浙江以東流亡十六七，吳郡、吳興戶口減半，又流奔而西者萬計。 十月，桓玄遣將擊劉軌，破走之。 軌奔青州。
Emperor An, third month, jiayin: many red meteors streamed west through key asterisms into the enclosure and Purple Palace. Meteors image commoners; a western swarm means columns fleeing west. Crossing the celestial court shows a feeble throne, mighty ministers, and uncontrollable regional armies." That May Sun En hit Wu commandery and slew its governor. June: he reached Jingkou. The capital region armed; Liu Yu chased and crushed Sun En. Yuanxing one, July: famine drove cannibalism. East of Zhe six or seven in ten fled; Wu and Wu-xing halved; tens of thousands bolted west. October: Huan Xuan’s column routed Liu Gui. Liu Gui fled to Qingzhou.
89
雲氣
Anomalous cloud vapors
90
惠帝十二月壬寅夜，有赤氣亙天，砰隱有聲。 二年十月丁丑，赤氣見北方，東西竟天。 占曰：「並為大兵。 砰隱有聲，怒之象也。 」是後，四海雲擾，九服交兵。
Huidi, December, renyin night: red qi bridged the sky with low thunder. Year two, October, dingchou: northern red qi stretched horizon to horizon. Both signs mean major war. The rumble images wrath. Then the realm boiled in war on every border.
91
十二月甲申，有白氣若虹，中天北下至地，夜見五日乃滅。 占曰：「大兵起。 」明年，王彌起青徐，汲桑亂河北，毒流天下。
December, jiashen: white arc from zenith to earth lasted five nights. Major war follows. Next year Wang Mi and Ji Sang’s risings poisoned the realm.
92
懷帝十一月乙亥，有白氣如帶，出南北方各二，起地至天，貫參伐中。 占曰：「天下大兵起。 」四年三月，司馬越收繆胤等。 又，三方雲擾，攻戰不休。 五年三月，司馬越死于甯平城，石勒攻破其眾，死者十餘萬人。 六月，京都焚滅，帝如虜庭。
Huaidi, November, yihai: paired white belts crossed Orion’s Blade. Realm-wide war is portended. Year four, March: Sima Yue seized Miao Yin and company. Three war zones seethed without pause. Year five, March: Yue died at Ningping; Shi Le annihilated his army, killing over a hundred thousand. June: Luoyang burned and the emperor fell captive.
93
愍帝十月己巳夜，有赤氣曜於西北。 荊州刺史陶侃討杜弢之党於石城，戰敗。
Mindi, October, jisi night: red qi flared northwest. Jing inspector Tao Kan attacked Du Tao’s allies at Stone City and lost.
